E: Modify the CIDR block of the subnet that is associated with the instances.
question_zh: 一名SysOps管理员无法在VPC中启动Amazon EC2实例，因为VPC中没有可用的私有IPv4地址。SysOps管理员必须采取哪些操作组合才能启动实例？（选择两个。）
A_zh: 将次级IPv4 CIDR块与VPC关联。
B_zh: 将主 IPv6 CIDR 块与 VPC 关联。
C_zh: 为VPC创建一个新的子网。
D_zh: 修改VPC的CIDR块。
E_zh: 修改与实例关联的子网的CIDR块。
question_zh_zh: A SysOps administrator cannot launch an Amazon EC2 instance in a VPC because there are no available private IPv4 addresses in the VPC. What combination of actions must the SysOps administrator take to launch the instance? (Choose two.)

question: A SysOps administrator is creating an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group in a new AWS account. After adding some instances, the SysOps administrator notices that the group has not reached the minimum number of instances. The SysOps administrator receives the following error message:  Launching a new EC2 instance. Status Reason: Your quota allows for 0 more running instance(s). You requested at least 1. Launching EC2 instance failed.  Which action will resolve this issue?
A: Adjust the account spending limits for Amazon EC2 on the AWS Billing and Cost Management console.
B: Modify the EC2 quota for that AWS Region in the EC2 Settings section of the EC2 console.
C: Request a quota increase for the instance type family by using Service Quotas on the AWS Management Console.
D: Use the Rebalance action in the Auto Scaling group on the AWS Management Console.
question_zh: 采取哪些措施可以解决此问题？
A_zh: 在AWS账单与成本管理控制台上调整Amazon EC2的账户支出限制。
B_zh: 在 EC2 控制台的 EC2 设置部分，修改该 AWS 区域的 EC2 配额。
C_zh: 在AWS管理控制台上使用服务配额申请该实例类型系列的配额增加。
D_zh: 在AWS管理控制台的自动扩展组中使用重新平衡操作。
question_zh_zh: 采取哪些措施可以解决此问题？

question: A SysOps administrator is creating two AWS CloudFormation templates. The first template will create a VPC with associated resources, such as subnets, route tables, and an internet gateway. The second template will deploy application resources within the VPC that was created by the first template. The second template should refer to the resources created by the first template.  How can this be accomplished with the LEAST amount of administrative effort?
A: Add an export field to the outputs of the first template and import the values in the second template.
B: Create a custom resource that queries the stack created by the first template and retrieves the required values.
C: Create a mapping in the first template that is referenced by the second template.
D: Input the names of resources in the first template and refer to those names in the second template as a parameter.
question_zh: 一名SysOps管理员正在创建两个AWS CloudFormation模板。第一个模板将创建一个VPC及其相关资源，如子网、路由表和互联网网关。第二个模板将在第一个模板创建的VPC内部署应用程序资源。第二个模板应引用第一个模板创建的资源。如何以最少的管理工作量实现这一目标？
A_zh: 在第一个模板的输出中添加一个导出字段，并在第二个模板中导入这些值。
B_zh: 创建一个自定义资源，查询由第一个模板创建的堆栈并获取所需的值。
C_zh: 在第一个模板中创建一个映射，该映射被第二个模板引用。
D_zh: 在第一个模板中输入资源的名称，并在第二个模板中将这些名称作为参数引用。
question_zh_zh: 一名SysOps管理员正在创建两个AWS CloudFormation模板。第一个模板将创建一个VPC及其相关资源，如子网、路由表和互联网网关。第二个模板将在第一个模板创建的VPC内部署应用程序资源。第二个模板应引用第一个模板创建的资源。如何以最少的管理工作量实现这一目标？

question: A company runs a web application on three Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The company notices that random periods of increased traffic cause a degradation in the application��s performance. A SysOps administrator must scale the application to meet the increased traffic.  Which solution meets these requirements?
A: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to monitor application latency and increase the size of each EC2 instance if the desired threshold is reached.
B: Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule to monitor application latency and add an EC2 instance to the ALB if the desired threshold is reached.
C: Deploy the application to an Auto Scaling group of EC2 instances with a target tracking scaling policy. Attach the ALB to the Auto Scaling group.
D: Deploy the application to an Auto Scaling group of EC2 instances with a scheduled scaling policy. Attach the ALB to the Auto Scaling group.
question_zh: 一家公司在一个应用负载均衡器（ALB）后面运行三个Amazon EC2实例的Web应用程序。公司注意到，随机的流量增加会导致应用程序性能下降。SysOps管理员必须对应用程序进行扩展以应对增加的流量。哪种解决方案能满足这些要求？
A_zh: 创建一个Amazon CloudWatch警报，用于监控应用程序延迟，并在达到预设阈值时增加每个EC2实例的规模。
B_zh: 创建一个 Amazon EventBridge（Amazon CloudWatch Events）规则，用于监控应用程序延迟，并在达到预设阈值时将 EC2 实例添加到应用负载均衡器（ALB）中。
C_zh: 将应用程序部署到具有目标追踪扩展策略的 EC2 实例自动伸缩组中。将应用负载均衡器（ALB）附加到自动伸缩组。
D_zh: 将应用程序部署到具有计划扩缩策略的 EC2 实例自动伸缩组中。将应用负载均衡器（ALB）附加到自动伸缩组。
question_zh_zh: 一家公司在一个应用负载均衡器（ALB）后面运行三个Amazon EC2实例的Web应用程序。公司注意到，随机的流量增加会导致应用程序性能下降。SysOps管理员必须对应用程序进行扩展以应对增加的流量。哪种解决方案能满足这些要求？

question: A company has a high-performance Windows workload. The workload requires a storage volume that provides consistent performance of 10,000 IOPS. The company does not want to pay for additional unneeded capacity to achieve this performance.  Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST cost?
A: Use a Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume that is configured with 10,000 provisioned IOPS.
B: Use a General Purpose SSD (gp3) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume that is configured with 10,000 provisioned IOPS.
C: Use an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system in Max I/O mode.
D: Use an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system that is configured with 10,000 IOPS.
question_zh: 一家公司有一个高性能的Windows工作负载。该工作负载需要一个提供稳定10,000 IOPS性能的存储卷。公司不想为额外不需要的容量付费以实现此性能。哪种解决方案以最低成本满足这些要求？
A_zh: 使用配置了10,000预配置IOPS的预置IOPS SSD（io1）亚马逊弹性块存储（Amazon EBS）卷。
B_zh: 使用配置有10,000预置IOPS的通用SSD（gp3）Amazon弹性块存储（Amazon EBS）卷。
C_zh: 在 Max I/O 模式下使用 Amazon Elastic File System（Amazon EFS）文件系统。
D_zh: 使用配置为10,000 IOPS的Amazon FSx for Windows文件服务器文件系统。
question_zh_zh: 哪种解决方案以最低成本满足这些要求？

question: A SysOps administrator must create a solution that automatically shuts down any Amazon EC2 instances that have less than 10% average CPU utilization for 60 minutes or more.  Which solution will meet this requirement in the MOST operationally efficient manner?
A: Implement a cron job on each EC2 instance to run once every 60 minutes and calculate the current CPU utilization. Initiate an instance shutdown if CPU utilization is less than 10%.
B: Implement an Amazon CloudWatch alarm for each EC2 instance to monitor average CPU utilization. Set the period at 1 hour, and set the threshold at 10%. Configure an EC2 action on the alarm to stop the instance.
C: Install the unified Amazon CloudWatch agent on each EC2 instance, and enable the Basic level predefined metric set. Log CPU utilization every 60 minutes, and initiate an instance shutdown if CPU utilization is less than 10%.
D: Use AWS Systems Manager Run Command to get CPU utilization from each EC2 instance every 60 minutes. Initiate an instance shutdown if CPU utilization is less than 10%.
question_zh: SysOps 管理员必须创建一个解决方案，自动关闭平均 CPU 利用率低于 10%且持续 60 分钟或更长时间的所有 Amazon EC2 实例。哪种解决方案在操作上最为高效？
A_zh: 在每个EC2实例上实现一个定时任务，每60分钟运行一次，计算当前的CPU利用率。如果CPU利用率低于10%，则启动实例关闭。
B_zh: 为每个EC2实例实现一个Amazon CloudWatch警报，用于监控平均CPU利用率。将周期设置为1小时，阈值设为10%。在警报上配置一个EC2操作，以停止该实例。
C_zh: 在每个EC2实例上安装统一的Amazon CloudWatch代理，并启用基本级别的预定义指标集。每60分钟记录一次CPU利用率，如果CPU利用率低于10%，则启动实例关闭。
D_zh: 使用AWS Systems Manager运行命令，每60分钟获取每个EC2实例的CPU利用率。如果CPU利用率低于10%，则启动实例关闭。
question_zh_zh: SysOps 管理员必须创建一个解决方案，自动关闭平均 CPU 利用率低于 10%且持续 60 分钟或更长时间的所有 Amazon EC2 实例。哪种解决方案在操作上最为高效？

question: A SysOps administrator is unable to authenticate an AWS CLI call to an AWS service.  Which of the following is the cause of this issue?
A: The IAM password is incorrect.
B: The server certificate is missing.
C: The SSH key pair is incorrect.
D: There is no access key.
question_zh: SysOps管理员无法验证对AWS服务的AWS CLI调用。以下哪项是导致此问题的原因？
A_zh: IAM密码不正确。
B_zh: 服务器证书缺失。
C_zh: SSH密钥对不正确。
D_zh: 没有访问密钥。
question_zh_zh: SysOps管理员无法验证对AWS服务的AWS CLI调用。以下哪项是导致此问题的原因？

question: A company requires that all IAM user accounts that have not been used for 90 days or more must have their access keys and passwords immediately disabled. A SysOps administrator must automate the process of disabling unused keys using the MOST operationally efficient method.  How should the SysOps administrator implement this solution?
A: Create an AWS Step Functions workflow to identify IAM users that have not been active for 90 days. Run an AWS Lambda function when a scheduled Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule is invoked to automatically remove the AWS access keys and passwords for these IAM users.
B: Configure an AWS Config rule to identify IAM users that have not been active for 90 days. Set up an automatic weekly batch process on an Amazon EC2 instance to disable the AWS access keys and passwords for these IAM users.
C: Develop and run a Python script on an Amazon EC2 instance to programmatically identify IAM users that have not been active for 90 days. Automatically delete these IAM users.
D: Set up an AWS Config managed rule to identify IAM users that have not been active for 90 days. Set up an AWS Systems Manager automation runbook to disable the AWS access keys for these IAM users.
question_zh: 一家公司要求所有未使用超过90天的IAM用户账户的访问密钥和密码必须立即禁用。一名SysOps管理员必须使用最具操作效率的方法自动化禁用未使用密钥的流程。SysOps管理员应如何实施该方案？
A_zh: 创建一个AWS Step Functions工作流程，用于识别已超过90天未活跃的IAM用户。当定期触发的Amazon EventBridge（Amazon CloudWatch Events）规则被调用时，运行一个AWS Lambda函数，自动删除这些IAM用户的AWS访问密钥和密码。
B_zh: 配置一个AWS Config规则，以识别90天未活动的IAM用户。在Amazon EC2实例上设置每周自动批处理流程，禁用这些IAM用户的AWS访问密钥和密码。
C_zh: 在亚马逊EC2实例上开发并运行一个Python脚本，自动识别90天未活跃的IAM用户，并自动删除这些IAM用户。
D_zh: 设置一个AWS Config托管规则，以识别90天未活跃的IAM用户。设置一个AWS Systems Manager自动化运行手册，以禁用这些IAM用户的AWS访问密钥。
question_zh_zh: 一名SysOps管理员应使用脚本或自动化工具（如AWS CLI、SDK或Lambda函数）定期检查IAM用户账户的访问密钥和密码的最后使用时间，识别未使用超过90天的账户，然后批量禁用这些账户的访问密钥和密码，以实现高效自动化管理。

question: A company creates custom AMI images by launching new Amazon EC2 instances from an AWS CloudFormation template. It installs and configures necessary software through AWS OpsWorks, and takes images of each EC2 instance. The process of installing and configuring software can take between 2 to 3 hours, but at times, the process stalls due to installation errors.  The SysOps administrator must modify the CloudFormation template so if the process stalls, the entire stack will fail and roll back.  Based on these requirements, what should be added to the template?
A: Conditions with a timeout set to 4 hours.
B: CreationPolicy with a timeout set to 4 hours.
C: DependsOn with a timeout set to 4 hours.
D: Metadata with a timeout set to 4 hours.
question_zh: 公司通过从AWS CloudFormation模板启动新的Amazon EC2实例来创建定制的AMI镜像。它通过AWS OpsWorks安装和配置必要的软件，并对每个EC2实例进行镜像。安装和配置软件的过程可能需要2到3个小时，但有时由于安装错误，过程会卡住。SysOps管理员必须修改CloudFormation模板，以便如果过程卡住，整个堆栈将失败并回滚。基于这些要求，应在模板中添加什么内容？
A_zh: 条件设置了4小时的超时时间。
B_zh: 创建策略，超时时间设为4小时。
C_zh: 依赖项，超时时间设置为4小时。
D_zh: 设置了4小时超时的元数据。
question_zh_zh: 为了确保在安装和配置软件过程中出现错误时，整个堆栈能够失败并回滚，应在CloudFormation模板中添加“创建策略”或“失败条件”。具体来说，可以在模板中加入“CreationPolicy”或“WaitCondition”资源，设置合理的失败条件和超时限制，以便在安装或配置过程出现错误时，自动中止堆栈的创建并进行回滚。

question: A company runs workloads on 90 Amazon EC2 instances in the eu-west-1 Region in an AWS account. In 2 months, the company will migrate the workloads from eu-west-1 to the eu-west-3 Region.  The company needs to reduce the cost of the EC2 instances. The company is willing to make a 1-year commitment that will begin next week. The company must choose an EC2 instance purchasing option that will provide discounts for the 90 EC2 instances regardless of Region during the 1-year period.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Purchase EC2 Standard Reserved Instances.
B: Purchase an EC2 Instance Savings Plan.
C: Purchase EC2 Convertible Reserved Instances.
D: Purchase a Compute Savings Plan.
question_zh: 一家公司在AWS账户的eu-west-1区域运行90个Amazon EC2实例的工作负载。两个月后，该公司将把工作负载从eu-west-1迁移到eu-west-3区域。公司需要降低EC2实例的成本。公司愿意做出为期一年的承诺，从下周开始。公司必须选择一种EC2实例购买选项，在为期一年的时间内，无论区域如何，都能为这90个EC2实例提供折扣。哪种解决方案能满足这些要求？
A_zh: 购买EC2标准预留实例。
B_zh: 购买一项EC2实例节省计划。
C_zh: 购买EC2可转换预留实例。
D_zh: 购买计算节省计划。
question_zh_zh: 一家公司在AWS账户的eu-west-1区域运行90个Amazon EC2实例的工作负载。两个月后，该公司将把工作负载从eu-west-1迁移到eu-west-3区域。公司需要降低EC2实例的成本。公司愿意做出为期一年的承诺，从下周开始。公司必须选择一种EC2实例购买选项，在为期一年的时间内，无论区域如何，都能为这90个EC2实例提供折扣。哪种解决方案能满足这些要求？

question: A SysOps administrator has created a VPC that contains a public subnet and a private subnet. Amazon EC2 instances that were launched in the private subnet cannot access the internet. The default network ACL is active on all subnets in the VPC, and all security groups allow all outbound traffic.  Which solution will provide the EC2 instances in the private subnet with access to the internet?
A: Create a NAT gateway in the public subnet. Create a route from the private subnet to the NAT gateway.
B: Create a NAT gateway in the public subnet. Create a route from the public subnet to the NAT gateway.
C: Create a NAT gateway in the private subnet. Create a route from the public subnet to the NAT gateway.
D: Create a NAT gateway in the private subnet. Create a route from the private subnet to the NAT gateway.
question_zh: 一个SysOps管理员创建了一个包含公共子网和私有子网的VPC。在私有子网中启动的Amazon EC2实例无法访问互联网。VPC中所有子网都启用了默认的网络ACL，且所有安全组都允许所有出站流量。哪种解决方案可以为私有子网中的EC2实例提供互联网访问？
A_zh: 在公共子网中创建一个 NAT 网关。从私有子网到 NAT 网关创建一条路由。
B_zh: 在公共子网中创建一个NAT网关。从公共子网到NAT网关创建一条路由。
C_zh: 在私有子网中创建一个 NAT 网关。从公共子网到 NAT 网关创建一条路由。
D_zh: 在私有子网中创建一个NAT网关。从私有子网到NAT网关创建一条路由。
question_zh_zh: 为私有子网中的EC2实例提供互联网访问的解决方案是：在VPC中创建一个NAT网关，并将私有子网的路由表指向该NAT网关。

question: A company plans to run a public web application on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Elastic Load Balancer (ELB). The company��s security team wants to protect the website by using AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) certificates. The ELB must automatically redirect any HTTP requests to HTTPS.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Create an Application Load Balancer that has one HTTPS listener on port 80. Attach an SSL/TLS certificate to listener port 80. Create a rule to redirect requests from HTTP to HTTPS.
B: Create an Application Load Balancer that has one HTTP listener on port 80 and one HTTPS protocol listener on port 443. Attach an SSL/TLS certificate to listener port 443. Create a rule to redirect requests from port 80 to port 443.
C: Create an Application Load Balancer that has two TCP listeners on port 80 and port 443. Attach an SSL/TLS certificate to listener port 443. Create a rule to redirect requests from port 80 to port 443.
D: Create a Network Load Balancer that has two TCP listeners on port 80 and port 443. Attach an SSL/TLS certificate to listener port 443. Create a rule to redirect requests from port 80 to port 443.
question_zh: 一家公司计划在Elastic Load Balancer（ELB）后面使用Amazon EC2实例运行一个公共Web应用程序。公司的安全团队希望通过使用AWS证书管理器（ACM）证书来保护网站。ELB必须自动将所有HTTP请求重定向到HTTPS。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？
A_zh: 创建一个应用程序负载均衡器，在端口80上设置一个HTTPS监听器。将SSL/TLS证书绑定到监听器端口80。创建一条规则，将请求从HTTP重定向到HTTPS。
B_zh: 创建一个应用程序负载均衡器，具有一个监听端口为80的HTTP监听器和一个监听端口为443的HTTPS协议监听器。将SSL/TLS证书附加到端口为443的监听器。创建一条规则，将来自端口80的请求重定向到端口443。
C_zh: 创建一个应用程序负载均衡器，具有两个TCP监听器，端口为80和443。将SSL/TLS证书附加到端口为443的监听器。创建一条规则，将来自端口80的请求重定向到端口443。
D_zh: 创建一个网络负载均衡器，在端口80和端口443上设置两个TCP监听器。将SSL/TLS证书绑定到端口443的监听器。创建一条规则，将端口80的请求重定向到端口443。
question_zh_zh: 哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

question: A company wants to track its AWS costs in all member accounts that are part of an organization in AWS Organizations. Managers of the member accounts want to receive a notification when the estimated costs exceed a predetermined amount each month. The managers are unable to configure a billing alarm. The IAM permissions for all users are correct.  What could be the cause of this issue?
A: The management/payer account does not have billing alerts turned on.
B: The company has not configured AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) to share billing information between the member accounts and the management/payer account.
C: Amazon GuardDuty is turned on for all the accounts.
D: The company has not configured an AWS Config rule to monitor billing.
question_zh: 原因可能是没有为成员账户配置账单通知或预算警报，或者没有在组织级别启用相关的账单通知功能。
A_zh: 管理/支付账户未开启账单提醒。
B_zh: 该公司尚未配置AWS资源访问管理器（AWS RAM）以在成员账户和管理/付款账户之间共享账单信息。
C_zh: 所有账户已开启亚马逊GuardDuty。
D_zh: 公司尚未配置AWS Config规则以监控账单。
question_zh_zh: The reason may be that billing notifications or budget alerts have not been configured for member accounts, or that the relevant billing notification features have not been enabled at the organizational level.

question: A company is using Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) to run a containerized application on Amazon EC2 instances. A SysOps administrator needs to monitor only traffic flows between the ECS tasks.  Which combination of steps should the SysOps administrator take to meet this requirement? (Choose two.)
A: Configure Amazon CloudWatch Logs on the elastic network interface of each task.
B: Configure VPC Flow Logs on the elastic network interface of each task.
C: Specify the awsvpc network mode in the task definition.
D: Specify the bridge network mode in the task definition.
E: Specify the host network mode in the task definition.
question_zh: 一家公司正在使用Amazon Elastic Container Service（Amazon ECS）在Amazon EC2实例上运行容器化应用程序。一名SysOps管理员需要仅监控ECS任务之间的流量。SysOps管理员应采取哪些步骤组合以满足此要求？（选择两个）
A_zh: 在每个任务的弹性网络接口上配置 Amazon CloudWatch 日志。
B_zh: 在每个任务的弹性网络接口上配置VPC流日志。
C_zh: 在任务定义中指定 awsvpc 网络模式。
D_zh: 在任务定义中指定桥接网络模式。
E_zh: 在任务定义中指定主机网络模式。
question_zh_zh: 一家公司正在使用Amazon Elastic Container Service（Amazon ECS）在Amazon EC2实例上运行容器化应用程序。一名SysOps管理员需要仅监控ECS任务之间的流量。SysOps管理员应采取哪些步骤组合以满足此要求？（选择两个）

question: A company uses AWS Organizations to manage multiple AWS accounts. The company��s SysOps team has been using a manual process to create and manage IAM roles. The team requires an automated solution to create and manage the necessary IAM roles for multiple AWS accounts.  What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that meets these requirements?
A: Create AWS CloudFormation templates. Reuse the templates to create the necessary IAM roles in each of the AWS accounts.
B: Use AWS Directory Service with AWS Organizations to automatically associate the necessary IAM roles with Microsoft Active Directory users.
C: Use AWS Resource Access Manager with AWS Organizations to deploy and manage shared resources across the AWS accounts.
D: Use AWS CloudFormation StackSets with AWS Organizations to deploy and manage IAM roles for the AWS accounts.
question_zh: 一家公司使用AWS组织来管理多个AWS账户。该公司的SysOps团队一直采用手动方式创建和管理IAM角色。团队需要一种自动化的解决方案，以为多个AWS账户创建和管理所需的IAM角色。满足这些需求的最具操作效率的解决方案是什么？
A_zh: 创建AWS CloudFormation模板。重复使用这些模板，在每个AWS账户中创建所需的IAM角色。
B_zh: 使用 AWS 目录服务与 AWS 组织自动将所需的 IAM 角色关联到 Microsoft Active Directory 用户。
C_zh: 使用 AWS 资源访问管理器与 AWS 组织，部署和管理跨 AWS 账户的共享资源。
D_zh: 使用 AWS CloudFormation StackSets 与 AWS 组织结合，部署和管理 AWS 账户的 IAM 角色。
question_zh_zh: 使用AWS组织中的AWS CloudFormation StackSets自动在多个账户中创建和管理IAM角色。

question: A SysOps administrator needs to configure automatic rotation for Amazon RDS database credentials. The credentials must rotate every 30 days. The solution must integrate with Amazon RDS.  Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
A: Store the credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store as a secure string. Configure automatic rotation with a rotation interval of 30 days.
B: Store the credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Configure automatic rotation with a rotation interval of 30 days.
C: Store the credentials in a file in an Amazon S3 bucket. Deploy an AWS Lambda function to automatically rotate the credentials every 30 days.
D: Store the credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Deploy an AWS Lambda function to automatically rotate the credentials every 30 days.
question_zh: SysOps 管理员需要为 Amazon RDS 数据库凭证配置自动轮换。凭证必须每30天轮换一次。解决方案必须与 Amazon RDS 集成。哪种方案能以最少的运营负担满足这些要求？
A_zh: 将凭据存储在AWS Systems Manager参数存储中，作为安全字符串。配置自动轮换，轮换间隔为30天。
B_zh: 将凭据存储在AWS Secrets Manager中。配置自动轮换，轮换间隔为30天。
C_zh: 将凭证存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中的文件中。部署一个 AWS Lambda 函数，每30天自动轮换凭证。
D_zh: 将凭证存储在AWS Secrets Manager中。部署一个AWS Lambda函数，每30天自动轮换凭证。
question_zh_zh: SysOps 管理员需要为 Amazon RDS 数据库凭证配置自动轮换。凭证必须每30天轮换一次。解决方案必须与 Amazon RDS 集成。哪种方案能以最少的运营负担满足这些要求？

question: A company��s SysOps administrator attempts to restore an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) snapshot. However, the snapshot is missing because another system administrator accidentally deleted the snapshot. The company needs the ability to recover snapshots for a specified period of time after snapshots are deleted.  Which solution will provide this functionality?
A: Turn on deletion protection on individual EBS snapshots that need to be kept.
B: Create an IAM policy that denies the deletion of EBS snapshots by using a condition statement for the snapshot age. Apply the policy to all users.
C: Create a Recycle Bin retention rule for EBS snapshots for the desired retention period.
D: Use Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) to schedule an AWS Lambda function to copy EBS snapshots to Amazon S3 Glacier.
question_zh: 一家公司 的 SysOps 管理员试图还原一个 Amazon Elastic Block Store（Amazon EBS）快照。然而，该快照丢失了，因为另一位系统管理员不小心删除了它。公司需要在快照被删除后的一段时间内能够恢复快照的功能。哪种解决方案可以实现此功能？
A_zh: 对需要保留的单个EBS快照开启删除保护。
B_zh: 创建一项IAM策略，使用条件语句基于快照的创建时间来拒绝删除EBS快照的操作。将该策略应用于所有用户。
C_zh: 为EBS快照创建一个回收站保留规则，设定所需的保留期限。
D_zh: 使用 Amazon EventBridge（Amazon CloudWatch Events）安排 AWS Lambda 函数，将 EBS 快照复制到 Amazon S3 Glacier。
question_zh_zh: 哪种解决方案可以在快照被删除后的一段时间内实现恢复快照的功能？

question: A SysOps administrator recently configured Amazon S3 Cross-Region Replication on an S3 bucket.  Which of the following does this feature replicate to the destination S3 bucket by default?
A: Objects in the source S3 bucket for which the bucket owner does not have permissions
B: Objects that are stored in S3 Glacier
C: Objects that existed before replication was configured
D: Object metadata
question_zh: 该功能默认会将源S3桶中的哪些内容复制到目标S3桶？
A_zh: 源S3存储桶中所有桶主没有权限的对象
B_zh: 存储在S3 Glacier中的对象
C_zh: 在配置复制之前存在的对象
D_zh: 对象元数据
question_zh_zh: 该功能默认会将源S3桶中的所有内容复制到目标S3桶。

question: A company has a workload that is sending log data to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. One of the fields includes a measure of application latency. A SysOps administrator needs to monitor the p90 statistic of this field over time.  What should the SysOps administrator do to meet this requirement?
A: Create an Amazon CloudWatch Contributor Insights rule on the log data.
B: Create a metric filter on the log data.
C: Create a subscription filter on the log data.
D: Create an Amazon CloudWatch Application Insights rule for the workload.
question_zh: 一家公司有一个工作负载，将日志数据发送到Amazon CloudWatch Logs。其中一个字段包含应用程序延迟的度量。一名SysOps管理员需要监控该字段的p90统计值随时间的变化。SysOps管理员应采取什么措施以满足此需求？
A_zh: 在日志数据上创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 贡献洞察规则。
B_zh: 在日志数据上创建一个指标过滤器。
C_zh: 在日志数据上创建订阅过滤器。
D_zh: 为工作负载创建一个Amazon CloudWatch应用程序洞察规则。
question_zh_zh: SysOps管理员应使用CloudWatch指标和仪表板，创建该字段的p90统计值的指标，并设置相应的监控和警报，以跟踪其随时间的变化。

question: A company wants to archive sensitive data on Amazon S3 Glacier. The company��s regulatory and compliance requirements do not allow any modifications to the data by any account.  Which solution meets these requirements?
A: Attach a vault lock policy to an S3 Glacier vault that contains the archived data. Use the lock ID to validate the vault lock policy after 24 hours.
B: Attach a vault lock policy to an S3 Glacier vault that contains the archived data. Use the lock ID to validate the vault lock policy within 24 hours.
C: Configure S3 Object Lock in governance mode. Upload all files after 24 hours.
D: Configure S3 Object Lock in governance mode. Upload all files within 24 hours.
question_zh: 公司希望将敏感数据存档到Amazon S3 Glacier。公司的监管和合规要求不允许任何账户对数据进行任何修改。哪种解决方案符合这些要求？
A_zh: 将保险库锁策略附加到包含归档数据的S3 Glacier保险库中。使用锁定ID在24小时后验证保险库锁策略。
B_zh: 将保险库锁定策略附加到包含归档数据的S3 Glacier保险库。使用锁定ID在24小时内验证保险库锁定策略。
C_zh: 将S3对象锁定配置为治理模式。所有文件在24小时后上传。
D_zh: 将S3对象锁定配置为治理模式。在24小时内上传所有文件。
question_zh_zh: 将数据存储在Amazon S3 Glacier的存档中，并启用存档锁定功能，以确保数据在存储期间无法被修改，从而满足监管和合规要求。

question: A company manages an application that uses Amazon ElastiCache for Redis with two extra-large nodes spread across two different Availability Zones. The company��s IT team discovers that the ElastiCache for Redis cluster has 75% freeable memory. The application must maintain high availability.  What is the MOST cost-effective way to resize the cluster?
A: Decrease the number of nodes in the ElastiCache for Redis cluster from 2 to 1.
B: Deploy a new ElastiCache for Redis cluster that uses large node types. Migrate the data from the original cluster to the new cluster. After the process is complete, shut down the original cluster.
C: Deploy a new ElastiCache for Redis cluster that uses large node types. Take a backup from the original cluster, and restore the backup in the new cluster. After the process is complete, shut down the original cluster.
D: Perform an online resizing for the ElastiCache for Redis cluster. Change the node types from extra-large nodes to large nodes.
question_zh: 一家公司管理一个使用两个不同可用区的超大节点的Amazon ElastiCache for Redis应用程序。公司的IT团队发现该Redis集群有75%的可释放内存。该应用程序必须保持高可用性。最具成本效益的调整集群规模的方法是什么？
A_zh: 将 ElastiCache for Redis 集群中的节点数从 2 个减少到 1 个。
B_zh: 部署一个使用大型节点类型的新的ElastiCache for Redis集群。将数据从原始集群迁移到新集群。完成后，关闭原始集群。
C_zh: 部署一个使用大型节点类型的新的ElastiCache for Redis集群。对原始集群进行备份，并在新集群中还原备份。完成后，关闭原始集群。
D_zh: 对ElastiCache for Redis集群进行在线扩容，将节点类型从超大节点更改为大节点。
question_zh_zh: 最具成本效益的调整集群规模的方法是增加节点数量以分散负载，同时确保每个节点的内存利用率保持在合理范围内，以维持高可用性。

question: A company must migrate its applications to AWS. The company is using Chef recipes for configuration management. The company wants to continue to use the existing Chef recipes after the applications are migrated to AWS.  What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that meets these requirements?
A: Use AWS CloudFormation to create an Amazon EC2 instance, install a Chef server, and add Chef recipes.
B: Use AWS CloudFormation to create a stack and add layers for Chef recipes.
C: Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk with the Docker platform to upload Chef recipes.
D: Use AWS OpsWorks to create a stack and add layers with Chef recipes.
question_zh: 公司必须将其应用程序迁移到AWS。该公司使用Chef配方进行配置管理。迁移到AWS后，公司希望继续使用现有的Chef配方。满足这些要求的最具运营效率的解决方案是什么？
A_zh: 使用AWS CloudFormation创建一个Amazon EC2实例，安装Chef服务器，并添加Chef配方。
B_zh: 使用AWS CloudFormation创建堆栈并添加Chef配方的层。
C_zh: 使用 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 和 Docker 平台上传 Chef 配方。
D_zh: 使用AWS OpsWorks创建一个堆栈并添加带有Chef配方的层。
question_zh_zh: 公司必须将其应用程序迁移到AWS。该公司使用Chef配方进行配置管理。迁移到AWS后，公司希望继续使用现有的Chef配方。满足这些要求的最具运营效率的解决方案是什么？

question: A company uses AWS Organizations to manage its AWS accounts. A SysOps administrator must create a backup strategy for all Amazon EC2 instances across all the company��s AWS accounts.  Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?
A: Deploy an AWS Lambda function to each account to run EC2 instance snapshots on a scheduled basis.
B: Create an AWS CloudFormation stack set in the management account to add an AutoBackup=True tag to every EC2 instance.
C: Use AWS Backup in the management account to deploy policies for all accounts and resources.
D: Use a service control policy (SCP) to run EC2 instance snapshots on a scheduled basis in each account.
question_zh: 一家公司使用 AWS 组织来管理其 AWS 账户。一名 SysOps 管理员必须为公司所有 AWS 账户中的所有 Amazon EC2 实例制定备份策略。哪种解决方案以最高的运营效率满足这些要求？
A_zh: 在每个账户中部署一个AWS Lambda函数，以按计划对EC2实例进行快照。
B_zh: 在管理账户中创建一个AWS CloudFormation堆栈集，为每个EC2实例添加AutoBackup=True标签。
C_zh: 在管理账户中使用AWS Backup为所有账户和资源部署策略。
D_zh: 使用服务控制策略（SCP）在每个账户中按计划运行EC2实例快照。
question_zh_zh: 哪种解决方案以最高的运营效率满足这些要求？

question: A SysOps administrator is reviewing VPC Flow Logs to troubleshoot connectivity issues in a VPC. While reviewing the logs, the SysOps administrator notices that rejected traffic is not listed.  What should the SysOps administrator do to ensure that all traffic is logged?
A: Create a new flow log that has a filter setting to capture all traffic.
B: Create a new flow log. Set the log record format to a custom format. Select the proper fields to include in the log.
C: Edit the existing flow log. Change the filter setting to capture all traffic.
D: Edit the existing flow log. Set the log record format to a custom format. Select the proper fields to include in the log.
question_zh: SysOps管理员正在查看VPC流日志，以排查VPC中的连接问题。在查看日志时，SysOps管理员注意到被拒绝的流量未被列出。SysOps管理员应采取什么措施以确保所有流量都被记录？
A_zh: 创建一个新的流量日志，设置过滤条件以捕获所有流量。
B_zh: 创建一个新的流日志。将日志记录格式设置为自定义格式。选择要包含在日志中的适当字段。
C_zh: 编辑现有的流量日志。将过滤器设置更改为捕获所有流量。
D_zh: 编辑现有的流日志。将日志记录格式设置为自定义格式。选择要包含在日志中的适当字段。
question_zh_zh: SysOps管理员应确保VPC流日志已启用所有流量的记录，包括被拒绝的流量。具体措施包括：检查流日志的配置，确保已启用所有流量的捕获；确认日志过滤器设置没有排除被拒绝的流量；必要时重新配置流日志以覆盖所有流量类型；以及确保日志存储和权限设置正确，以便完整记录所有连接信息。

question: A company is expanding its use of AWS services across its portfolios. The company wants to provision AWS accounts for each team to ensure a separation of business processes for security, compliance, and billing. Account creation and bootstrapping should be completed in a scalable and efficient way so new accounts are created with a defined baseline and governance guardrails in place. A SysOps administrator needs to design a provisioning process that saves time and resources.  Which action should be taken to meet these requirements?
A: Automate using AWS Elastic Beanstalk to provision the AWS accounts, set up infrastructure, and integrate with AWS Organizations.
B: Create bootstrapping scripts in AWS OpsWorks and combine them with AWS CloudFormation templates to provision accounts and infrastructure.
C: Use AWS Config to provision accounts and deploy instances using AWS Service Catalog.
D: Use AWS Control Tower to create a template in Account Factory and use the template to provision new accounts.
question_zh: 一家公司正在扩大其在各个业务组合中对AWS服务的使用。该公司希望为每个团队预配AWS账户，以确保业务流程的安全、合规和账单的分离。账户的创建和初始化应以可扩展且高效的方式完成，以便新账户在创建时具有定义的基础配置和治理守则。一名SysOps管理员需要设计一个节省时间和资源的预配流程。应采取哪些措施以满足这些要求？
A_zh: 使用AWS Elastic Beanstalk自动化配置AWS账户、搭建基础设施，并与AWS组织集成。
B_zh: 在AWS OpsWorks中创建引导脚本，并将其与AWS CloudFormation模板结合使用，以配置账户和基础设施。
C_zh: 使用AWS Config配置账户并通过AWS Service Catalog部署实例。
D_zh: 使用AWS Control Tower在账户工厂中创建模板，并使用该模板来配置新账户。
question_zh_zh: 一家公司正在扩大其在各个业务组合中对AWS服务的使用。该公司希望为每个团队预配AWS账户，以确保业务流程的安全、合规和账单的分离。账户的创建和初始化应以可扩展且高效的方式完成，以便新账户在创建时具有定义的基础配置和治理守则。一名SysOps管理员需要设计一个节省时间和资源的预配流程。应采取哪些措施以满足这些要求？

question: A SysOps administrator noticed that the cache hit ratio for an Amazon CloudFront distribution is less than 10%.  Which collection of configuration changes will increase the cache hit ratio for the distribution? (Choose two.)
A: Ensure that only required cookies, query strings, and headers are forwarded in the Cache Behavior Settings.
B: Change the Viewer Protocol Policy to use HTTPS only.
C: Configure the distribution to use presigned cookies and URLs to restrict access to the distribution.
D: Enable automatic compression of objects in the Cache Behavior Settings.
E: Increase the CloudFront time to live (TTL) settings in the Cache Behavior Settings.
question_zh: 一名SysOps管理员注意到某个Amazon CloudFront分发的缓存命中率低于10%。哪些配置更改组合可以提高该分发的缓存命中率？（选择两个）
A_zh: 确保在缓存行为设置中只转发所需的 cookies、查询字符串和头部。
B_zh: 将查看器协议策略更改为仅使用HTTPS。
C_zh: 配置分发以使用预签名的Cookie和URL来限制对分发的访问。
D_zh: 在缓存行为设置中启用对象的自动压缩。
E_zh: 在缓存行为设置中增加CloudFront的存活时间（TTL）设置。
question_zh_zh: A SysOps administrator notices that the cache hit rate for a certain Amazon CloudFront distribution is below 10%. Which configuration changes can be combined to improve the cache hit rate for that distribution? (Choose two)

question: A SysOps administrator is attempting to download patches from the internet into an instance in a private subnet. An internet gateway exists for the VPC, and a NAT gateway has been deployed on the public subnet; however, the instance has no internet connectivity. The resources deployed into the private subnet must be inaccessible directly from the public internet.  Public Subnet (10.0.1.0/24) Route Table  Destination Target -10.0.0.0/16 local 0.0.0.0/0 IGW  Private Subnet (10.0.2.0/24) Route Table  Destination Target -10.0.0.0/16 local  What should be added to the private subnet��s route table in order to address this issue, given the information provided?
question_zh: 一名SysOps管理员试图从互联网下载补丁到私有子网中的实例。该VPC已存在互联网网关，并在公共子网部署了NAT网关，但该实例没有互联网连接。部署在私有子网中的资源必须不能被公共互联网直接访问。公共子网（10.0.1.0/24）路由表：目标 -10.0.0.0/16，目标 -0.0.0.0/0，目标类型 -互联网网关（IGW）。私有子网（10.0.2.0/24）路由表：目标 -10.0.0.0/16，目标 -0.0.0.0/0，目标类型 -本地。为了应对这个问题，应该在私有子网的路由表中添加什么内容？
B_zh: 0.0.0.0/0 网络地址转换
question_zh_zh: 在私有子网的路由表中添加一条指向NAT网关的路由，目标为0.0.0.0/0，目标类型为“目标”，指向NAT网关的ID。

question: A company is undergoing an external audit of its systems, which run wholly on AWS. A SysOps administrator must supply documentation of Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) compliance for the infrastructure managed by AWS.  Which set of actions should the SysOps administrator take to meet this requirement?
A: Download the applicable reports from the AWS Artifact portal and supply these to the auditors.
B: Download complete copies of the AWS CloudTrail log files and supply these to the auditors.
C: Download complete copies of the AWS CloudWatch logs and supply these to the auditors.
D: Provide the auditors with administrative access to the production AWS account so that the auditors can determine compliance.
question_zh: SysOps管理员应采取哪些措施，以满足提供由AWS管理基础设施的支付卡行业数据安全标准（PCI DSS）合规性文件的要求？
A_zh: 从AWS Artifact门户下载相关报告并提供给审计员。
B_zh: 下载完整的AWS CloudTrail日志文件，并将其提供给审计员。
C_zh: 下载完整的AWS CloudWatch日志副本并提供给审计员。
D_zh: 为审计员提供对生产AWS账户的管理权限，以便审计员能够判断合规性。
question_zh_zh: SysOps管理员应采取哪些措施，以满足由AWS管理基础设施的支付卡行业数据安全标准（PCI DSS）合规性文件的要求？

question: A company has an initiative to reduce costs associated with Amazon EC2 and AWS Lambda.  Which action should a SysOps administrator take to meet these requirements?
A: Analyze the AWS Cost and Usage Report by using Amazon Athena to identify cost savings.
B: Create an AWS Budgets alert to alarm when account spend reaches 80% of the budget.
C: Purchase Reserved Instances through the Amazon EC2 console.
D: Use AWS Compute Optimizer and take action on the provided recommendations.
question_zh: 一家公司正在采取措施降低与Amazon EC2和AWS Lambda相关的成本。SysOps管理员应采取哪些措施以满足这些要求？
A_zh: 使用Amazon Athena分析AWS成本与使用报告，以识别节省成本的机会。
B_zh: 创建一个AWS预算警报，当账户支出达到预算的80%时发出警报。
C_zh: 通过 Amazon EC2 控制台购买预留实例。
D_zh: 使用AWS计算优化器并根据提供的建议采取行动。
question_zh_zh: 一家公司正在采取措施降低与Amazon EC2和AWS Lambda相关的成本。SysOps管理员应采取哪些措施以满足这些要求？

question: A company wants to use only IPv6 for all its Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances must not be accessible from the internet, but the EC2 instances must be able to access the internet. The company creates a dual-stack VPC and IPv6-only subnets.  How should a SysOps administrator configure the VPC to meet these requirements?
A: Create and attach a NAT gateway. Create a custom route table that includes an entry to point all IPv6 traffic to the NAT gateway. Attach the custom route table to the IPv6-only subnets.
B: Create and attach an internet gateway. Create a custom route table that includes an entry to point all IPv6 traffic to the internet gateway. Attach the custom route table to the IPv6-only subnets.
C: Create and attach an egress-only internet gateway. Create a custom route table that includes an entry to point all IPv6 traffic to the egress-only internet gateway. Attach the custom route table to the IPv6-only subnets.
D: Create and attach an internet gateway and a NAT gateway. Create a custom route table that includes an entry to point all IPv6 traffic to the internet gateway and all IPv4 traffic to the NAT gateway. Attach the custom route table to the IPv6-only subnets.
question_zh: 一家公司希望其所有的Amazon EC2实例仅使用IPv6。EC2实例不能被互联网访问，但必须能够访问互联网。该公司创建了一个双栈VPC和仅支持IPv6的子网。SysOps管理员应如何配置VPC以满足这些要求？
A_zh: 创建并附加一个NAT网关。创建一个自定义路由表，其中包含一条将所有IPv6流量指向NAT网关的条目。将自定义路由表附加到仅支持IPv6的子网。
B_zh: 创建并附加一个互联网网关。创建一个自定义路由表，其中包含一条将所有IPv6流量指向互联网网关的条目。将自定义路由表附加到仅支持IPv6的子网。
C_zh: 创建并附加一个仅出互联网网关。创建一个自定义路由表，其中包含一条将所有IPv6流量指向该出互联网网关的条目。将自定义路由表附加到仅支持IPv6的子网。
D_zh: 创建并附加一个互联网网关和一个NAT网关。创建一个自定义路由表，其中包含一条条目，将所有IPv6流量指向互联网网关，将所有IPv4流量指向NAT网关。将自定义路由表附加到仅支持IPv6的子网。
question_zh_zh: 一家公司希望其所有的Amazon EC2实例仅使用IPv6。EC2实例不能被互联网访问，但必须能够访问互联网。该公司创建了一个双栈VPC和仅支持IPv6的子网。SysOps管理员应如何配置VPC以满足这些要求？

question: A company has an existing web application that runs on two Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) across two Availability Zones. The application uses an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB Instance. Amazon Route 53 record sets route requests for dynamic content to the load balancer and requests for static content to an Amazon S3 bucket. Site visitors are reporting extremely long loading times.  Which actions should be taken to improve the performance of the website? (Choose two.)
A: Add Amazon CloudFront caching for static content.
B: Change the load balancer listener from HTTPS to TCP.
C: Enable Amazon Route 53 latency-based routing.
D: Implement Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling for the web servers.
E: Move the static content from Amazon S3 to the web servers.
question_zh: 一家公司拥有一个现有的Web应用程序，该应用程序在两个可用区的应用负载均衡器（ALB）后面运行在两个Amazon EC2实例上。该应用程序使用Amazon RDS多可用区数据库实例。Amazon Route 53的记录集将动态内容的请求路由到负载均衡器，将静态内容的请求路由到Amazon S3存储桶。网站访问者报告加载时间非常长。应采取哪些措施以改善网站性能？（选择两个。）
A_zh: 为静态内容添加亚马逊CloudFront缓存。
B_zh: 将负载均衡器监听器从HTTPS更改为TCP。
C_zh: 启用 Amazon Route 53 基于延迟的路由。
D_zh: 为网页服务器实现亚马逊EC2自动伸缩。
E_zh: 将静态内容从亚马逊S3迁移到网页服务器。
question_zh_zh: 一家公司拥有一个现有的Web应用程序，该应用程序在两个可用区的应用负载均衡器（ALB）后面运行在两个Amazon EC2实例上。该应用程序使用Amazon RDS多可用区数据库实例。Amazon Route 53的记录集将动态内容的请求路由到负载均衡器，将静态内容的请求路由到Amazon S3存储桶。网站访问者报告加载时间非常长。应采取哪些措施以改善网站性能？（选择两个。）

question: A company is running an application on premises and wants to use AWS for data backup. All of the data must be available locally. The backup application can write only to block-based storage that is compatible with the Portable Operating System Interface (POSIX).  Which backup solution will meet these requirements?
A: Configure the backup software to use Amazon S3 as the target for the data backups.
B: Configure the backup software to use Amazon S3 Glacier as the target for the data backups.
C: Use AWS Storage Gateway, and configure it to use gateway-cached volumes.
D: Use AWS Storage Gateway, and configure it to use gateway-stored volumes.
question_zh: 一家公司在本地运行一个应用程序，想使用AWS进行数据备份。所有数据必须在本地可用。备份应用程序只能写入与可移植操作系统接口（POSIX）兼容的块存储。哪种备份解决方案可以满足这些要求？
A_zh: 将备份软件配置为使用亚马逊S3作为数据备份的目标。
B_zh: 将备份软件配置为使用亚马逊S3 Glacier作为数据备份的目标。
C_zh: 使用AWS存储网关，并将其配置为使用网关缓存卷。
D_zh: 使用AWS存储网关，并将其配置为使用网关存储卷。
question_zh_zh: 哪种备份解决方案可以满足这些要求？

question: A global company handles a large amount of personally identifiable information (PII) through an internal web portal. The company��s application runs in a corporate data center that is connected to AWS through an AWS Direct Connect connection. The application stores the PII in Amazon S3. According to a compliance requirement, traffic from the web portal to Amazon S3 must not travel across the internet.  What should a SysOps administrator do to meet the compliance requirement?
A: Provision an interface VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. Modify the application to use the interface endpoint.
B: Configure AWS Network Firewall to redirect traffic to the internal S3 address.
C: Modify the application to use the S3 path-style endpoint.
D: Set up a range of VPC network ACLs to redirect traffic to the internal S3 address.
question_zh: 一家公司通过内部网页门户处理大量的个人身份信息（PII）。该公司的应用程序在一个企业数据中心运行，并通过AWS Direct Connect连接到AWS。应用程序将PII存储在Amazon S3中。根据合规要求，网页门户到Amazon S3的流量不得经过互联网。SysOps管理员应采取什么措施以满足合规要求？
A_zh: 为 Amazon S3 配置接口 VPC 终端节点。修改应用程序以使用该接口终端节点。
B_zh: 配置AWS网络防火墙，将流量重定向到内部S3地址。
C_zh: 将应用程序修改为使用S3路径式端点。
D_zh: 设置一系列VPC网络ACL，将流量重定向到内部的S3地址。
question_zh_zh: SysOps管理员应配置AWS Direct Connect以建立专用连接，并使用VPC终端节点（VPC Endpoint）或AWS PrivateLink将网页门户与Amazon S3连接，确保流量不经过互联网，从而满足合规要求。

question: A SysOps administrator notices a scale-up event for an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group. Amazon CloudWatch shows a spike in the RequestCount metric for the associated Application Load Balancer. The administrator would like to know the IP addresses for the source of the requests.  Where can the administrator find this information?
A: Auto Scaling logs
B: AWS CloudTrail logs
C: EC2 instance logs
D: Elastic Load Balancer access logs
question_zh: 管理员可以在应用程序负载均衡器的访问日志中找到请求源的IP地址。
A_zh: 自动扩展日志
B_zh: AWS CloudTrail 日志
C_zh: EC2实例日志
D_zh: 弹性负载均衡器访问日志
question_zh_zh: 管理员可以在应用程序负载均衡器的访问日志中找到请求源的IP地址。

question: A company��s SysOps administrator deploys a public Network Load Balancer (NLB) in front of the company��s web application. The web application does not use any Elastic IP addresses. Users must access the web application by using the company��s domain name. The SysOps administrator needs to configure Amazon Route 53 to route traffic to the NLB.  Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
A: Create a Route 53 AAAA record for the NLB.
B: Create a Route 53 alias record for the NLB.
C: Create a Route 53 CAA record for the NLB.
D: Create a Route 53 CNAME record for the NLB.
question_zh: 公司SysOps管理员在公司网页应用前部署了一个公共网络负载均衡器（NLB）。该网页应用未使用任何弹性IP地址。用户必须通过公司的域名访问该网页应用。SysOps管理员需要配置Amazon Route 53，将流量路由到NLB。哪种解决方案最具成本效益地满足这些需求？
A_zh: 为网络负载均衡器（NLB）创建一个 Route 53 的 AAAA 记录。
B_zh: 为网络负载均衡器（NLB）创建一个Route 53别名记录。
C_zh: 为NLB创建一个Route 53的CAA记录。
D_zh: 为NLB创建一个Route 53的CNAME记录。
question_zh_zh: 公司SysOps管理员在公司网页应用前部署了一个公共网络负载均衡器（NLB）。该网页应用未使用任何弹性IP地址。用户必须通过公司的域名访问该网页应用。SysOps管理员需要配置Amazon Route 53，将流量路由到NLB。哪种解决方案最具成本效益地满足这些需求？

question: A company runs an encrypted Amazon RDS for Oracle DB instance. The company wants to make regular backups available in another AWS Region.  What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that meets these requirements?
A: Modify the DB instance. Enable cross-Region automated backups.
B: Create an RDS read replica in another Region. Create a snapshot of the read replica.
C: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to copy the data to a DB instance in another Region.
D: Temporarily turn off encryption on the DB instance. Take a snapshot. Copy the snapshot to another Region.
question_zh: 一家公司运行加密的Amazon RDS for Oracle数据库实例。该公司希望在另一个AWS区域中提供定期备份。满足这些需求的最具操作效率的解决方案是什么？
A_zh: 修改数据库实例。启用跨区域自动备份。
B_zh: 在另一个区域创建一个 RDS 只读副本。创建该只读副本的快照。
C_zh: 使用AWS数据库迁移服务（AWS DMS）将数据复制到另一个区域的数据库实例中。
D_zh: 暂时关闭数据库实例的加密。进行快照。将快照复制到另一个区域。
question_zh_zh: 在另一个AWS区域中设置自动快照复制，并配置跨区域备份策略，以实现定期备份。

question: A company is rolling out a new version of its website. Management wants to deploy the new website in a limited rollout to 20% of the company��s customers. The company uses Amazon Route 53 for its website��s DNS solution.  Which configuration will meet these requirements?
A: Create a failover routing policy. Within the policy, configure 80% of the website traffic to be sent to the original resource. Configure the remaining 20% of traffic as the failover record that points to the new resource.
B: Create a multivalue answer routing policy. Within the policy, create 4 records with the name and IP address of the original resource. Configure 1 record with the name and IP address of the new resource.
C: Create a latency-based routing policy. Within the policy, configure a record pointing to the original resource with a weight of 80. Configure a record pointing to the new resource with a weight of 20.
D: Create a weighted routing policy. Within the policy, configure a weight of 80 for the record pointing to the original resource. Configure a weight of 20 for the record pointing to the new resource.
question_zh: 一家公司正在推出其网站的新版本。管理层希望将新网站有限地推送给公司20%的客户。该公司使用Amazon Route 53作为其网站的DNS解决方案。哪种配置可以满足这些要求？
A_zh: 创建一个故障转移路由策略。在策略中，将80%的网站流量配置为发送到原始资源。将剩余的20%流量配置为指向新资源的故障转移记录。
B_zh: 创建一个多值答案路由策略。在策略中，创建4个记录，包含原始资源的名称和IP地址。配置1个记录，包含新资源的名称和IP地址。
C_zh: 创建一个基于延迟的路由策略。在策略中，配置一个指向原始资源的记录，权重为80。配置一个指向新资源的记录，权重为20。
D_zh: 创建一个加权路由策略。在策略中，将指向原始资源的记录的权重设置为80，将指向新资源的记录的权重设置为20。
question_zh_zh: 哪种配置可以满足将新网站有限推送给公司20%客户的要求？

question: A SysOps administrator created an AWS CloudFormation template that provisions Amazon EC2 instances, an Elastic Load Balancer (ELB), and an Amazon RDS DB instance. During stack creation, the creation of the EC2 instances and the creation of the ELB are successful. However, the creation of the DB instance fails.  What is the default behavior of CloudFormation in this scenario?
A: CloudFormation will roll back the stack and delete the stack.
B: CloudFormation will roll back the stack but will not delete the stack.
C: CloudFormation will prompt the user to roll back the stack or continue.
D: CloudFormation will successfully complete the stack but will report a failed status for the DB instance.
question_zh: 在这种情况下，CloudFormation的默认行为是回滚所有已成功创建的资源，包括EC2实例和ELB，以确保堆栈保持一致性。
A_zh: CloudFormation 将回滚堆栈并删除该堆栈。
B_zh: CloudFormation 将回滚堆栈，但不会删除堆栈。
C_zh: CloudFormation 会提示用户回滚堆栈或继续。
D_zh: CloudFormation 将成功完成堆栈，但会报告数据库实例的状态为失败。
question_zh_zh: In this case, CloudFormation's default behavior is to roll back all successfully created resources, including EC2 instances and ELBs, to ensure stack consistency.

question: A SysOps administrator needs to automate the invocation of an AWS Lambda function. The Lambda function must run at the end of each day to generate a report on data that is stored in an Amazon S3 bucket.  What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that meets these requirements?
A: Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule that has an event pattern for Amazon S3 and the Lambda function as a target.
B: Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule that has a schedule and the Lambda function as a target.
C: Create an S3 event notification to invoke the Lambda function whenever objects change in the S3 bucket.
D: Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance with a cron job to invoke the Lambda function.
question_zh: SysOps 管理员需要自动调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数。该 Lambda 函数必须在每天结束时运行，以生成存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中的数据的报告。满足这些需求的操作上最高效的解决方案是什么？
A_zh: 创建一个Amazon EventBridge（Amazon CloudWatch Events）规则，该规则具有针对Amazon S3的事件模式，并将Lambda函数作为目标。
B_zh: 创建一个具有调度计划的 Amazon EventBridge（Amazon CloudWatch Events）规则，并将 Lambda 函数设为目标。
C_zh: 创建一个S3事件通知，在S3存储桶中的对象发生变化时调用Lambda函数。
D_zh: 部署一个带有定时任务的Amazon EC2实例，以调用Lambda函数。
question_zh_zh: SysOps 管理员需要自动调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数。该 Lambda 函数必须在每天结束时运行，以生成存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中的数据的报告。满足这些需求的操作上最高效的解决方案是什么？

question: A company is releasing a new static website hosted on Amazon S3. The static website hosting feature was enabled on the bucket and content was uploaded; however, upon navigating to the site, the following error message is received:  403 Forbidden - Access Denied  What change should be made to fix this error?
A: Add a bucket policy that grants everyone read access to the bucket.
B: Add a bucket policy that grants everyone read access to the bucket objects.
C: Remove the default bucket policy that denies read access to the bucket.
D: Configure cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) on the bucket.
question_zh: 应对该错误，应修改存储桶的权限设置，确保存储桶策略允许公共读取访问。具体措施包括：配置存储桶策略以允许所有用户（匿名用户）读取存储桶中的内容，或者设置存储桶的访问权限为“公共读取”。这样，访问者才能正常访问静态网站内容。
A_zh: 添加一个存储桶策略，授予所有人对该存储桶的读取权限。
B_zh: 添加一个存储桶策略，授予所有人对存储桶对象的读取权限。
C_zh: 删除拒绝对存储桶读取访问的默认存储桶策略。
D_zh: 在存储桶上配置跨源资源共享（CORS）。
question_zh_zh: To address this error, modify the permissions settings of the bucket to ensure that the bucket policy allows public read access. Specific measures include: configuring the bucket policy to allow all users (anonymous users) to read the contents of the bucket, or setting the bucket's access permissions to "public read." This way, visitors can properly access the static website content.

question: A company uses AWS Organizations. A SysOps administrator wants to use AWS Compute Optimizer and AWS tag policies in the management account to govern all member accounts in the billing family. The SysOps administrator navigates to the AWS Organizations console but cannot activate tag policies through the management account.  What could be the reason for this issue?
A: All features have not been enabled in the organization.
B: Consolidated billing has not been enabled.
C: The member accounts do not have tags enabled for cost allocation.
D: The member accounts have not manually enabled trusted access for Compute Optimizer.
question_zh: 原因可能是因为AWS标签策略在管理账户中尚未启用或未正确配置，或者该账户没有足够的权限来激活标签策略。此外，AWS Compute Optimizer和标签策略可能需要在特定的条件下启用，或者需要在组织的管理账户中进行特定的设置。
A_zh: 组织中尚未启用所有功能。
B_zh: 未启用合并账单。
C_zh: 成员账户未启用成本分配的标签。
D_zh: 成员账户尚未手动启用计算优化器的可信访问。
question_zh_zh: The reason may be that the AWS tag policy has not been enabled or properly configured in the management account, or that the account does not have sufficient permissions to activate the tag policy. Additionally, AWS Compute Optimizer and tag policies may need to be enabled under specific conditions or require specific settings in the organization's management account.

question: A company is storing media content in an Amazon S3 bucket and uses Amazon CloudFront to distribute the content to its users. Due to licensing terms, the company is not authorized to distribute the content in some countries. A SysOps administrator must restrict access to certain countries.  What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that meets these requirements?
A: Configure the S3 bucket policy to deny the GetObject operation based on the S3:LocationConstraint condition.
B: Create a secondary origin access identity (OAI). Configure the S3 bucket policy to prevent access from unauthorized countries.
C: Enable the geo restriction feature in the CloudFront distribution to prevent access from unauthorized countries.
D: Update the application to generate signed CloudFront URLs only for IP addresses in authorized counties.
question_zh: 公司将媒体内容存储在Amazon S3存储桶中，并使用Amazon CloudFront将内容分发给用户。由于许可条款，公司未被授权在某些国家分发内容。一名SysOps管理员必须限制对某些国家的访问。满足这些要求的最具操作效率的解决方案是什么？
A_zh: 配置S3存储桶策略，基于S3:LocationConstraint条件拒绝GetObject操作。
B_zh: 创建一个二级源访问身份（OAI）。配置S3存储桶策略，阻止来自未经授权国家的访问。
C_zh: 在CloudFront分发中启用地理限制功能，以防止未授权国家的访问。
D_zh: 更新应用程序，仅为授权县的IP地址生成签名的CloudFront URL。
question_zh_zh: 公司将媒体内容存储在Amazon S3存储桶中，并使用Amazon CloudFront将内容分发给用户。由于许可条款，公司未被授权在某些国家分发内容。一名SysOps管理员必须限制对某些国家的访问。满足这些要求的最具操作效率的解决方案是什么？

question: A SysOps administrator created an Amazon VPC with an IPv6 CIDR block, which requires access to the internet. However, access from the internet towards the VPC is prohibited. After adding and configuring the required components to the VPC, the administrator is unable to connect to any of the domains that reside on the internet.  What additional route destination rule should the administrator add to the route tables?
A: Route ::/0 traffic to a NAT gateway
B: Route ::/0 traffic to an internet gateway
C: Route 0.0.0.0/0 traffic to an egress-only internet gateway
D: Route ::/0 traffic to an egress-only internet gateway
question_zh: 管理员应在路由表中添加一条指向互联网网关（Internet Gateway）的默认路由（0.0.0.0/0），以允许VPC中的实例访问互联网。
A_zh: 将所有流量路由到 NAT 网关
B_zh: 将所有流量（::/0）路由到互联网网关
C_zh: 将0.0.0.0/0的流量路由到仅出口互联网网关
D_zh: 将所有流量（::/0）路由到仅出口的互联网网关
question_zh_zh: 管理员应在路由表中添加一条指向互联网网关（Internet Gateway）的默认路由（0.0.0.0/0），以允许VPC中的实例访问互联网。

question: A company hosts several write-intensive applications. These applications use a MySQL database that runs on a single Amazon EC2 instance. The company asks a SysOps administrator to implement a highly available database solution that is ideal for multi-tenant workloads.  Which solution should the SysOps administrator implement to meet these requirements?
A: Create a second EC2 instance for MySQL. Configure the second instance to be a read replica.
B: Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora DB cluster. Add an Aurora Replica.
C: Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora multi-master DB cluster.
D: Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance.
question_zh: 公司托管多个写入密集型应用程序。这些应用程序使用在单个Amazon EC2实例上运行的MySQL数据库。公司要求SysOps管理员实施一种高度可用的数据库解决方案，适用于多租户工作负载。SysOps管理员应实施哪种解决方案以满足这些要求？
A_zh: 创建第二个EC2实例用于MySQL。将第二个实例配置为只读副本。
B_zh: 将数据库迁移到Amazon Aurora数据库集群。添加一个Aurora副本。
C_zh: 将数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora 多主机数据库集群。
D_zh: 将数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库实例。
question_zh_zh: 公司托管多个写入密集型应用程序。这些应用程序在单个Amazon EC2实例上运行MySQL数据库。公司要求SysOps管理员实施一种高度可用的数据库解决方案，适用于多租户工作负载。SysOps管理员应实施哪种解决方案以满足这些要求？

question: A company has a memory-intensive application that runs on a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances behind an Elastic Load Balancer (ELB). The instances run in an Auto Scaling group. A SysOps administrator must ensure that the application can scale based on the number of users that connect to the application.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Create a scaling policy that will scale the application based on the ActiveConnectionCount Amazon CloudWatch metric that is generated from the ELB.
B: Create a scaling policy that will scale the application based on the mem_used Amazon CloudWatch metric that is generated from the ELB.
C: Create a scheduled scaling policy to increase the number of EC2 instances in the Auto Scaling group to support additional connections.
D: Create and deploy a script on the ELB to expose the number of connected users as a custom Amazon CloudWatch metric. Create a scaling policy that uses the metric.
question_zh: 一家公司有一个内存密集型应用程序，在一个由弹性负载均衡器（ELB）后面的Amazon EC2实例群上运行。这些实例运行在自动扩展组中。一名SysOps管理员必须确保应用程序能够根据连接到应用程序的用户数量进行扩展。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？
A_zh: 创建一个扩展策略，根据由ELB生成的ActiveConnectionCount Amazon CloudWatch指标对应用程序进行扩展。
B_zh: 创建一个基于由ELB生成的mem_used Amazon CloudWatch指标的扩展策略，用于自动扩展应用程序。
C_zh: 创建一个定时扩展策略，以增加自动扩展组中的EC2实例数量，以支持更多连接。
D_zh: 在ELB上创建并部署脚本，以将连接用户数作为自定义的Amazon CloudWatch指标进行暴露。创建一个使用该指标的自动扩展策略。
question_zh_zh: 哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

question: A SysOps administrator creates a new VPC that includes a public subnet and a private subnet. The SysOps administrator successfully launches 11 Amazon EC2 instances in the private subnet. The SysOps administrator attempts to launch one more EC2 instance in the same subnet. However, the SysOps administrator receives an error message that states that not enough free IP addresses are available.  What must the SysOps administrator do to deploy more EC2 instances?
A: Edit the private subnet to change the CIDR block to /27.
B: Edit the private subnet to extend across a second Availability Zone.
C: Assign additional Elastic IP addresses to the private subnet.
D: Create a new private subnet to hold the required EC2 instances.
question_zh: SysOps 管理员必须增加子网中的可用 IP 地址数量，方法包括扩大子网的 CIDR 范围或创建新的子网，以便为更多的 EC2 实例分配 IP 地址。
A_zh: 编辑私有子网，将CIDR块更改为/27。
B_zh: 将私有子网编辑为跨越第二个可用区。
C_zh: 为私有子网分配额外的弹性IP地址。
D_zh: 创建一个新的私有子网以容纳所需的EC2实例。
question_zh_zh: SysOps 管理员必须增加子网中的可用 IP 地址数量，方法包括扩大子网的 CIDR 范围或创建新的子网，以便为更多的 EC2 实例分配 IP 地址。

question: A company needs to automatically monitor an AWS account for potential unauthorized AWS Management Console logins from multiple geographic locations.  Which solution will meet this requirement?
A: Configure Amazon Cognito to detect any compromised IAM credentials.
B: Set up Amazon Inspector. Scan and monitor resources for unauthorized logins.
C: Set up AWS Config. Add the iam-policy-blacklisted-check managed rule to the account.
D: Configure Amazon GuardDuty to monitor the UnauthorizedAccess:IAMUser/ConsoleLoginSuccess.B finding.
question_zh: 一家公司需要自动监控AWS账户，以检测来自多个地理位置的潜在未经授权的AWS管理控制台登录。哪种解决方案可以满足此需求？
A_zh: 配置 Amazon Cognito 以检测任何被泄露的 IAM 凭证。
B_zh: 设置亚马逊检测器。扫描并监控资源的未授权登录。
C_zh: 设置AWS配置。在账户中添加iam-policy-blacklisted-check托管规则。
D_zh: 配置 Amazon GuardDuty 以监控 UnauthorizedAccess:IAMUser/ConsoleLoginSuccess.B 发现。
question_zh_zh: 哪种解决方案可以满足一家公司自动监控AWS账户以检测来自多个地理位置的潜在未经授权的AWS管理控制台登录的需求？

question: A company has an Amazon RDS DB instance. The company wants to implement a caching service while maintaining high availability.  Which combination of actions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
A: Add Auto Discovery to the data store.
B: Create an Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached data store.
C: Create an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis data store.
D: Enable Multi-AZ for the data store.
E: Enable Multi-threading for the data store.
question_zh: 一家公司拥有一个Amazon RDS数据库实例。该公司希望在保持高可用性的同时实现缓存服务。哪些操作组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两个。）
A_zh: 在数据存储中添加自动发现功能。
B_zh: 创建一个用于 Memcached 的 Amazon ElastiCache 数据存储。
C_zh: 创建一个用于 Redis 的 Amazon ElastiCache 数据存储。
D_zh: 为数据存储启用多可用区（Multi-AZ）。
E_zh: 为数据存储启用多线程。
question_zh_zh: A company has an Amazon RDS database instance. The company wants to implement caching services while maintaining high availability. Which combinations of actions can meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

question: A company monitors its account activity using AWS CloudTrail, and is concerned that some log files are being tampered with after the logs have been delivered to the account��s Amazon S3 bucket.  Moving forward, how can the SysOps administrator confirm that the log files have not been modified after being delivered to the S3 bucket?
A: Stream the CloudTrail logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs to store logs at a secondary location.
B: Enable log file integrity validation and use digest files to verify the hash value of the log file.
C: Replicate the S3 log bucket across regions, and encrypt log files with S3 managed keys.
D: Enable S3 server access logging to track requests made to the log bucket for security audits.
question_zh: 一家公司使用AWS CloudTrail监控其账户活动，并担心一些日志文件在传送到账户的Amazon S3存储桶后被篡改。今后，SysOps管理员如何确认日志文件在传送到S3存储桶后没有被修改？
A_zh: 将 CloudTrail 日志流式传输到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs，以在备用位置存储日志。
B_zh: 启用日志文件完整性验证，并使用摘要文件来验证日志文件的哈希值。
C_zh: 在多个区域复制S3日志存储桶，并使用S3管理的密钥对日志文件进行加密。
D_zh: 启用S3服务器访问日志记录，以跟踪对日志存储桶的请求，用于安全审计。
question_zh_zh: SysOps管理员可以启用AWS CloudTrail的“日志文件完整性验证”功能，以确保传送到S3存储桶的日志文件未被篡改。具体方法包括：在创建或更新CloudTrail时，启用“日志文件完整性验证”选项，CloudTrail会为每个日志文件生成数字签名，并将签名存储在S3存储桶中。管理员可以使用提供的验证工具或脚本，定期验证日志文件的完整性，确保其未被修改。

question: A SysOps administrator is reviewing AWS Trusted Advisor warnings and encounters a warning for an S3 bucket policy that has open access permissions. While discussing the issue with the bucket owner, the administrator realizes the S3 bucket is an origin for an Amazon CloudFront web distribution.  Which action should the administrator take to ensure that users access objects in Amazon S3 by using only CloudFront URLs?
A: Encrypt the S3 bucket content with Server-Side Encryption with Amazon S3-Managed Keys (SSE-S3).
B: Create an origin access identity and grant it permissions to read objects in the S3 bucket.
C: Assign an IAM user to the CloudFront distribution and grant the user permissions in the S3 bucket policy.
D: Assign an IAM role to the CloudFront distribution and grant the role permissions in the S3 bucket policy.
question_zh: 该管理员应配置CloudFront以强制使用其分配的域名访问S3对象，或者在S3存储桶策略中限制直接访问，只允许通过CloudFront的URL访问，从而确保用户仅通过CloudFront URL访问Amazon S3中的对象。
A_zh: 使用Amazon S3管理密钥的服务器端加密（SSE-S3）对S3存储桶内容进行加密。
B_zh: 创建一个源访问身份，并授予其读取S3存储桶中对象的权限。
C_zh: 将IAM用户分配给CloudFront分发，并在S3存储桶策略中授予该用户权限。
D_zh: 为CloudFront分发分配一个IAM角色，并在S3存储桶策略中授予该角色权限。
question_zh_zh: 该管理员应配置CloudFront以强制使用其分配的域名访问S3对象，或者在S3存储桶策略中限制直接访问，只允许通过CloudFront的URL访问，从而确保用户仅通过CloudFront URL访问Amazon S3中的对象。

question: A SysOps administrator is reviewing AWS Trusted Advisor recommendations. The SysOps administrator notices that all the application servers for a finance application are listed in the Low Utilization Amazon EC2 Instances check. The application runs on three instances across three Availability Zones. The SysOps administrator must reduce the cost of running the application without affecting the application��s availability or design.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Reduce the number of application servers.
B: Apply rightsizing recommendations from AWS Cost Explorer to reduce the instance size.
C: Provision an Application Load Balancer in front of the instances.
D: Scale up the instance size of the application servers.
question_zh: 一名SysOps管理员正在审核AWS Trusted Advisor的建议。该管理员注意到，所有用于金融应用的应用服务器都被列在“低利用率的Amazon EC2实例”检查中。该应用在三个可用区的三个实例上运行。SysOps管理员必须在不影响应用的可用性或设计的情况下，降低运行成本。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？
A_zh: 减少应用服务器的数量。
B_zh: 应用AWS成本管理器的合理化建议，缩小实例规模。
C_zh: 在实例前配置一个应用程序负载均衡器。
D_zh: 扩大应用服务器的实例规模。
question_zh_zh: 一名SysOps管理员正在审核AWS Trusted Advisor的建议。该管理员注意到，所有用于金融应用的应用服务器都被列在“低利用率的Amazon EC2实例”检查中。该应用在三个可用区的三个实例上运行。SysOps管理员必须在不影响应用的可用性或设计的情况下，降低运行成本。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

question: A company hosts its website in the us-east-1 Region. The company is preparing to deploy its website into the eu-central-1 Region. Website visitors who are located in Europe should access the website that is hosted in eu-central-1. All other visitors access the website that is hosted in us-east-1. The company uses Amazon Route 53 to manage the website��s DNS records.  Which routing policy should a SysOps administrator apply to the Route 53 record set to meet these requirements?
A: Geolocation routing policy
B: Geoproximity routing policy
C: Latency routing policy
D: Multivalue answer routing policy
question_zh: 一家公司在us-east-1区域托管其网站。该公司正准备将其网站部署到eu-central-1区域。位于欧洲的访问者应访问托管在eu-central-1的网页。所有其他访问者则访问托管在us-east-1的网页。该公司使用Amazon Route 53管理网站的DNS记录。SysOps管理员应对Route 53记录集应用哪种路由策略以满足这些要求？
A_zh: 地理位置路由策略
B_zh: 地理邻近路由策略
C_zh: 延迟路由策略
D_zh: 多值答案路由策略
question_zh_zh: SysOps管理员应在Route 53中应用基于位置的路由策略（Geolocation Routing Policy），将欧洲访问者定向到eu-central-1区域的网页，其他访问者则定向到us-east-1区域的网页。

question: An organization with a large IT department has decided to migrate to AWS. With different job functions in the IT department, it is not desirable to give all users access to all AWS resources. Currently the organization handles access via LDAP group membership.  What is the BEST method to allow access using current LDAP credentials?
A: Create an AWS Directory Service Simple AD. Replicate the on-premises LDAP directory to Simple AD.
B: Create a Lambda function to read LDAP groups and automate the creation of IAM users.
C: Use AWS CloudFormation to create IAM roles. Deploy Direct Connect to allow access to the on-premises LDAP server.
D: Federate the LDAP directory with IAM using SAML. Create different IAM roles to correspond to different LDAP groups to limit permissions.
question_zh: 一个拥有庞大IT部门的组织已决定迁移到AWS。由于IT部门的不同岗位职能，不希望所有用户都能访问所有AWS资源。目前，该组织通过LDAP组成员身份来管理访问权限。使用现有LDAP凭据允许访问的最佳方法是什么？
A_zh: 创建一个AWS目录服务Simple AD。将本地LDAP目录复制到Simple AD。
B_zh: 创建一个Lambda函数，用于读取LDAP组并自动创建IAM用户。
C_zh: 使用AWS CloudFormation创建IAM角色。部署Direct Connect以允许访问本地LDAP服务器。
D_zh: 使用SAML将LDAP目录与IAM联合起来。创建不同的IAM角色以对应不同的LDAP组，从而限制权限。
question_zh_zh: 使用现有LDAP凭据进行身份验证的最佳方法是将LDAP集成到AWS身份和访问管理（IAM）中，利用AWS的联合身份验证功能（如AWS Single Sign-On或通过SAML 2.0集成），以便根据LDAP组成员身份控制对不同AWS资源的访问。

question: A SysOps administrator has created an Amazon EC2 instance using an AWS CloudFormation template in the us-east-1 Region. The administrator finds that this template has failed to create an EC2 instance in the us-west-2 Region.  What is one cause for this failure?
A: Resource tags defined in the CloudFormation template are specific to the us-east-1 Region.
B: The Amazon Machine Image (AMI) ID referenced in the CloudFormation template could not be found in the us-west-2 Region.
C: The cfn-init script did not run during resource provisioning in the us-west-2 Region.
D: The IAM user was not created in the specified Region.
question_zh: 原因之一是模板中可能没有指定在us-west-2区域创建EC2实例的相关配置或资源限制。
A_zh: 在CloudFormation模板中定义的资源标签仅适用于us-east-1区域。
B_zh: 在 us-west-2 区域中找不到 CloudFormation 模板中引用的 Amazon 机器映像（AMI）ID。
C_zh: 在 us-west-2 区域的资源配置过程中，cfn-init 脚本未运行。
D_zh: 该 IAM 用户未在指定区域创建。
question_zh_zh: One reason is that the template may not specify the configuration or resource limits for creating EC2 instances in the us-west-2 region.

question: A global gaming company is preparing to launch a new game on AWS. The game runs in multiple AWS Regions on a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances. The instances are in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in each Region. The company plans to use Amazon Route 53 for DNS services. The DNS configuration must direct users to the Region that is closest to them and must provide automated failover.  Which combination of steps should a SysOps administrator take to configure Route 53 to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
A: Create Amazon CloudWatch alarms that monitor the health of the ALB in each Region. Configure Route 53 DNS failover by using a health check that monitors the alarms.
B: Create Amazon CloudWatch alarms that monitor the health of the EC2 instances in each Region. Configure Route 53 DNS failover by using a health check that monitors the alarms.
C: Configure Route 53 DNS failover by using a health check that monitors the private IP address of an EC2 instance in each Region.
D: Configure Route 53 geoproximity routing. Specify the Regions that are used for the infrastructure.
E: Configure Route 53 simple routing. Specify the continent, country, and state or province that are used for the infrastructure.
question_zh: 一家全球游戏公司正准备在AWS上推出一款新游戏。该游戏在多个AWS区域内的Amazon EC2实例群上运行。实例位于每个区域的自动扩展组后面，并通过应用负载均衡器（ALB）进行管理。公司计划使用Amazon Route 53作为DNS服务。DNS配置必须将用户引导到离他们最近的区域，并且必须提供自动故障转移。SysOps管理员应采取哪些步骤组合，以配置Route 53以满足这些要求？（选择两个）
A_zh: 创建监控每个区域中应用程序负载均衡器（ALB）健康状况的Amazon CloudWatch警报。通过使用监控这些警报的健康检查，配置Route 53 DNS故障转移。
B_zh: 创建监控每个区域中EC2实例健康状况的Amazon CloudWatch警报。通过使用监控这些警报的健康检查，配置Route 53 DNS故障转移。
C_zh: 通过使用监控每个区域中EC2实例私有IP地址的健康检查，配置Route 53 DNS故障转移。
D_zh: 配置 Route 53 地理邻近路由。指定用于基础设施的区域。
E_zh: 配置 Route 53 简单路由。指定用于基础设施的大陆、国家和州或省份。
question_zh_zh: 一家全球游戏公司正准备在AWS上推出一款新游戏。该游戏在多个AWS区域内的Amazon EC2实例群上运行。实例位于每个区域的自动扩展组后面，并通过应用负载均衡器（ALB）进行管理。公司计划使用Amazon Route 53作为DNS服务。DNS配置必须将用户引导到离他们最近的区域，并且必须提供自动故障转移。SysOps管理员应采取哪些步骤组合，以配置Route 53以满足这些要求？（选择两个）

question: A SysOps administrator is investigating a company��s web application for performance problems. The application runs on Amazon EC2 instances that are in an Auto Scaling group. The application receives large traffic increases at random times throughout the day. During periods of rapid traffic increases, the Auto Scaling group is not adding capacity fast enough. As a result, users are experiencing poor performance.  The company wants to minimize costs without adversely affecting the user experience when web traffic surges quickly. The company needs a solution that adds more capacity to the Auto Scaling group for larger traffic increases than for smaller traffic increases.  How should the SysOps administrator configure the Auto Scaling group to meet these requirements?
A: Create a simple scaling policy with settings to make larger adjustments in capacity when the system is under heavy load.
B: Create a step scaling policy with settings to make larger adjustments in capacity when the system is under heavy load.
C: Create a target tracking scaling policy with settings to make larger adjustments in capacity when the system is under heavy load.
D: Use Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling lifecycle hooks. Adjust the Auto Scaling group��s maximum number of instances after every scaling event.
question_zh: 一名SysOps管理员正在调查公司网页应用的性能问题。该应用运行在一个Auto Scaling组中的Amazon EC2实例上。应用在一天中的随机时间会出现大量流量增加。在流量快速增长期间，Auto Scaling组的扩容速度不足，导致用户体验变差。公司希望在不影响用户体验的前提下，最大程度地降低成本，尤其是在流量快速激增时。公司需要一种解决方案，能够根据流量的大小，为Auto Scaling组添加不同的容量：对于较大的流量增加，增加更多的容量；对于较小的流量增加，增加较少的容量。SysOps管理员应如何配置Auto Scaling组以满足这些需求？
A_zh: 创建一个简单的扩展策略，设置在系统负载较重时进行更大规模的容量调整。
B_zh: 创建一个逐步扩展策略，在系统负载较重时进行更大幅度的容量调整。
C_zh: 创建一个目标跟踪缩放策略，在系统负载较重时进行更大幅度的容量调整。
D_zh: 使用 Amazon EC2 自动扩展生命周期钩子。在每次扩展事件后调整自动扩展组的最大实例数。
question_zh_zh: 一名SysOps管理员正在调查公司网页应用的性能问题。该应用运行在一个Auto Scaling组中的Amazon EC2实例上。应用在一天中的随机时间会出现大量流量增加。在流量快速增长期间，Auto Scaling组的扩容速度不足，导致用户体验变差。公司希望在不影响用户体验的前提下，最大程度地降低成本，尤其是在流量快速激增时。公司需要一种解决方案，能够根据流量的大小，为Auto Scaling组添加不同的容量：对于较大的流量增加，增加更多的容量；对于较小的流量增加，增加较少的容量。SysOps管理员应如何配置Auto Scaling组以满足这些需求？

question: A company has a compliance requirement that no security groups can allow SSH ports to be open to all IP addresses. A SysOps administrator must implement a solution that will notify the company��s SysOps team when a security group rule violates this requirement. The solution also must remediate the security group rule automatically.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule that invokes an AWS Lambda function when a security group changes. Configure the Lambda function to evaluate the security group for compliance, remove all inbound security group rules on all ports, and notify the SysOps team if the security group is noncompliant.
B: Create an AWS CloudTrail metric filter for security group changes. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to notify the SysOps team through an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic when the metric is greater than 0. Subscribe an AWS Lambda function to the SNS topic to remediate the security group rule by removing the rule.
C: Activate the AWS Config restricted-ssh managed rule. Add automatic remediation to the AWS Config rule by using the AWS Systems Manager Automation AWS-DisablePublicAccessForSecurityGroup runbook. Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule to notify the SysOps team when the rule is noncompliant.
D: Create an AWS CloudTrail metric filter for security group changes. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm for when the metric is greater than 0. Add an AWS Systems Manager action to the CloudWatch alarm to suspend the security group by using the Systems Manager Automation AWS-DisablePublicAccessForSecurityGroup runbook when the alarm is in ALARM state. Add an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic as a second target to notify the SysOps team.
question_zh: 一家公司有一项合规要求，禁止安全组允许SSH端口对所有IP地址开放。SysOps管理员必须实施一个解决方案，在安全组规则违反此要求时通知公司的SysOps团队。该方案还必须自动修复安全组规则。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？
A_zh: 创建一个 Amazon EventBridge（Amazon CloudWatch Events）规则，在安全组发生更改时调用 AWS Lambda 函数。配置该 Lambda 函数以评估安全组的合规性，删除所有端口的入站安全组规则，并在安全组不合规时通知 SysOps 团队。
B_zh: 为安全组更改创建一个AWS CloudTrail指标过滤器。当指标大于0时，创建一个Amazon CloudWatch警报，通过Amazon Simple Notification Service（SNS）主题通知SysOps团队。将一个AWS Lambda函数订阅到该SNS主题，以通过删除规则来修复安全组规则。
C_zh: 激活AWS Config限制性SSH管理规则。通过使用AWS Systems Manager Automation的AWS-DisablePublicAccessForSecurityGroup运行手册，为AWS Config规则添加自动修复。创建一个Amazon EventBridge（Amazon CloudWatch Events）规则，在规则不合规时通知SysOps团队。
D_zh: 为安全组变更创建一个AWS CloudTrail指标过滤器。当指标大于0时，为Amazon CloudWatch设置一个警报。在CloudWatch警报中添加一个AWS Systems Manager操作，当警报处于“告警”状态时，使用Systems Manager自动化运行簿AWS-DisablePublicAccessForSecurityGroup暂停安全组。将一个Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）主题作为第二个目标，用于通知SysOps团队。
question_zh_zh: 哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

question: A company has an application that runs only on Amazon EC2 Spot Instances. The instances run in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group with scheduled scaling actions. However, the capacity does not always increase at the scheduled times, and instances terminate many times a day. A SysOps administrator must ensure that the instances launch on time and have fewer interruptions.  Which action will meet these requirements?
A: Specify the capacity-optimized allocation strategy for Spot Instances. Add more instance types to the Auto Scaling group.
B: Specify the capacity-optimized allocation strategy for Spot Instances. Increase the size of the instances in the Auto Scaling group.
C: Specify the lowest-price allocation strategy for Spot Instances. Add more instance types to the Auto Scaling group.
D: Specify the lowest-price allocation strategy for Spot Instances. Increase the size of the instances in the Auto Scaling group.
question_zh: 一家公司拥有一个仅在亚马逊EC2竞价实例上运行的应用程序。这些实例运行在具有预定扩展操作的亚马逊EC2自动扩展组中。然而，容量并不总是在预定时间增加，而且实例每天会多次终止。一名SysOps管理员必须确保实例按时启动并减少中断。哪项措施可以满足这些要求？
A_zh: 为竞价实例指定容量优化的分配策略。向自动伸缩组添加更多实例类型。
B_zh: 为竞价实例指定容量优化的分配策略。增加自动伸缩组中实例的规模。
C_zh: 为竞价实例指定最低价分配策略。向自动伸缩组添加更多实例类型。
D_zh: 为Spot实例指定最低价分配策略。增加自动伸缩组中实例的规模。
question_zh_zh: 一家公司拥有一个仅在亚马逊EC2竞价实例上运行的应用程序。这些实例运行在具有预定扩展操作的亚马逊EC2自动扩展组中。然而，容量并不总是在预定时间增加，而且实例每天会多次终止。一名SysOps管理员必须确保实例按时启动并减少中断。哪项措施可以满足这些要求？

question: A company plans to deploy a database on an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB cluster. The database will store data for a demonstration environment. The data must be reset on a daily basis.  What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that meets these requirements?
A: Create a manual snapshot of the DB cluster after the data has been populated. Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function on a daily basis. Configure the function to restore the snapshot and then delete the previous DB cluster.
B: Enable the Backtrack feature during the creation of the DB cluster. Specify a target backtrack window of 48 hours. Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function on a daily basis. Configure the function to perform a backtrack operation.
C: Export a manual snapshot of the DB cluster to an Amazon S3 bucket after the data has been populated. Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function on a daily basis. Configure the function to restore the snapshot from Amazon S3.
D: Set the DB cluster backup retention period to 2 days. Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function on a daily basis. Configure the function to restore the DB cluster to a point in time and then delete the previous DB cluster.
question_zh: 一家公司计划在Amazon Aurora MySQL数据库集群上部署一个数据库。该数据库将用于演示环境的数据存储，数据必须每天重置一次。满足这些要求的最具操作效率的解决方案是什么？
A_zh: 在数据填充完成后，为数据库集群创建一个手动快照。创建一个 Amazon EventBridge（Amazon CloudWatch Events）规则，每天调用一次 AWS Lambda 函数。配置该函数以还原快照，然后删除之前的数据库集群。
B_zh: 在创建数据库集群时启用回溯功能。指定目标回溯窗口为48小时。创建一个Amazon EventBridge（Amazon CloudWatch Events）规则，每天调用一次AWS Lambda函数。配置该函数以执行回溯操作。
C_zh: 在数据填充完成后，将数据库集群的手动快照导出到Amazon S3存储桶。创建一个Amazon EventBridge（Amazon CloudWatch Events）规则，每天调用一次AWS Lambda函数。配置该函数从Amazon S3还原快照。
D_zh: 将数据库集群的备份保留时间设置为2天。创建一个Amazon EventBridge（Amazon CloudWatch Events）规则，每天调用一次AWS Lambda函数。配置该函数以在特定时间点还原数据库集群，然后删除之前的数据库集群。
question_zh_zh: 在Amazon Aurora MySQL数据库集群上部署一个数据库，用于演示环境的数据存储，并且每天重置一次，最具操作效率的解决方案是什么？

question: A SysOps administrator is setting up an automated process to recover an Amazon EC2 instance in the event of an underlying hardware failure. The recovered instance must have the same private IP address and the same Elastic IP address that the original instance had. The SysOps team must receive an email notification when the recovery process is initiated.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm for the EC2 instance, and specify the StatusCheckFailed_Instance metric. Add an EC2 action to the alarm to recover the instance. Add an alarm notification to publish a message to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe the SysOps team email address to the SNS topic.
B: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm for the EC2 instance, and specify the StatusCheckFailed_System metric. Add an EC2 action to the alarm to recover the instance. Add an alarm notification to publish a message to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe the SysOps team email address to the SNS topic.
C: Create an Auto Scaling group across three different subnets in the same Availability Zone with a minimum, maximum, and desired size of 1. Configure the Auto Scaling group to use a launch template that specifies the private IP address and the Elastic IP address. Add an activity notification for the Auto Scaling group to send an email message to the SysOps team through Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES).
D: Create an Auto Scaling group across three Availability Zones with a minimum, maximum, and desired size of 1. Configure the Auto Scaling group to use a launch template that specifies the private IP address and the Elastic IP address. Add an activity notification for the Auto Scaling group to publish a message to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe the SysOps team email address to the SNS topic.
question_zh: SysOps 管理员正在设置一个自动化流程，以在底层硬件故障时恢复 Amazon EC2 实例。恢复的实例必须具有与原始实例相同的私有IP地址和弹性IP地址。SysOps 团队在恢复过程启动时必须收到电子邮件通知。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？
A_zh: 为EC2实例创建一个Amazon CloudWatch警报，并指定StatusCheckFailed_Instance指标。为该警报添加一个EC2操作以恢复实例。添加警报通知，将消息发布到Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）主题。将SysOps团队的电子邮件地址订阅到该SNS主题。
B_zh: 为EC2实例创建一个Amazon CloudWatch警报，并指定StatusCheckFailed_System指标。为该警报添加一个EC2操作以恢复实例。添加一个警报通知，将消息发布到Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）主题。将SysOps团队的电子邮件地址订阅到该SNS主题。
C_zh: 在同一可用区的三个不同子网中创建一个自动扩展组，最小、最大和期望容量均为1。将自动扩展组配置为使用一个启动模板，模板中指定私有IP地址和弹性IP地址。为自动扩展组添加活动通知，通过Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES)向SysOps团队发送电子邮件。
D_zh: 在三个可用区创建一个自动扩展组，最小、最大和期望容量均为1。将自动扩展组配置为使用一个启动模板，该模板指定私有IP地址和弹性IP地址。为自动扩展组添加活动通知，以将消息发布到Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）主题。将SysOps团队的电子邮件地址订阅到该SNS主题。
question_zh_zh: SysOps 管理员正在设置一个自动化流程，以在底层硬件故障时恢复 Amazon EC2 实例。恢复的实例必须具有与原始实例相同的私有IP地址和弹性IP地址。SysOps 团队在恢复过程启动时必须收到电子邮件通知。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

question: A company has a public website that recently experienced problems. Some links led to missing webpages, and other links rendered incorrect webpages. The application infrastructure was running properly, and all the provisioned resources were healthy. Application logs and dashboards did not show any errors, and no monitoring alarms were raised. Systems administrators were not aware of any problems until end users reported the issues.  The company needs to proactively monitor the website for such issues in the future and must implement a solution as soon as possible.  Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
A: Rewrite the application to surface a custom error to the application log when issues occur. Automatically parse logs for errors. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to provide alerts when issues are detected.
B: Create an AWS Lambda function to test the website. Configure the Lambda function to emit an Amazon CloudWatch custom metric when errors are detected. Configure a CloudWatch alarm to provide alerts when issues are detected.
C: Create an Amazon CloudWatch Synthetics canary. Use the CloudWatch Synthetics Recorder plugin to generate the script for the canary run. Configure the canary in line with requirements. Create an alarm to provide alerts when issues are detected.
D: In the Amazon CloudWatch console, turn on Application Insights. Create a CloudWatch alarm to provide alerts when an issue is detected.
question_zh: 一家公司拥有一个公共网站，最近遇到了一些问题。一些链接指向了不存在的网页，其他链接则显示了错误的网页。应用基础设施运行正常，所有配置的资源都处于健康状态。应用日志和仪表盘没有显示任何错误，也没有触发监控警报。系统管理员直到最终用户报告问题之前都未意识到任何问题。公司需要主动监控网站以防止此类问题的发生，并且必须尽快实施解决方案。哪种方案能以最低的运营负担满足这些需求？
A_zh: 重写应用程序，在出现问题时向应用程序日志中显示自定义错误。自动解析日志中的错误。创建一个Amazon CloudWatch警报，在检测到问题时提供提醒。
B_zh: 创建一个AWS Lambda函数来测试网站。配置该Lambda函数在检测到错误时发出一个Amazon CloudWatch自定义指标。配置一个CloudWatch警报，在检测到问题时提供提醒。
C_zh: 创建一个Amazon CloudWatch Synthetics金丝雀。使用CloudWatch Synthetics Recorder插件生成金丝雀运行的脚本。根据需求配置金丝雀。创建一个警报，在检测到问题时提供提醒。
D_zh: 在 Amazon CloudWatch 控制台中，开启应用程序洞察。创建一个 CloudWatch 警报，以在检测到问题时提供警报。
question_zh_zh: 公司需要实施主动监控工具，如网站监控服务或应用性能监控（APM）解决方案，以持续检测链接状态和网页内容的变化。这些工具可以自动检测死链、错误页面和内容偏差，及时发出警报，帮助系统管理员在用户报告问题之前发现潜在问题。选择自动化程度高、配置简便、维护成本低的监控方案，能够以最低的运营负担实现持续监控和快速响应。

question: A SysOps administrator is responsible for a company��s security groups. The company wants to maintain a documented trail of any changes that are made to the security groups. The SysOps administrator must receive notification whenever the security groups change.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Set up Amazon Detective to record security group changes. Specify an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group to store configuration history logs. Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue for notifications about configuration changes. Subscribe the SysOps administrator��s email address to the SQS queue.
B: Set up AWS Systems Manager Change Manager to record security group changes. Specify an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group to store configuration history logs. Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic for notifications about configuration changes. Subscribe the SysOps administrator��s email address to the SNS topic.
C: Set up AWS Config to record security group changes. Specify an Amazon S3 bucket as the location for configuration snapshots and history files. Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic for notifications about configuration changes. Subscribe the SysOps administrator��s email address to the SNS topic.
D: Set up Amazon Detective to record security group changes. Specify an Amazon S3 bucket as the location for configuration snapshots and history files. Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic for notifications about configuration changes. Subscribe the SysOps administrator��s email address to the SNS topic.
question_zh: SysOps管理员负责公司的安全组。公司希望对安全组的任何更改都保留书面记录。SysOps管理员必须在安全组发生更改时收到通知。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？
A_zh: 设置 Amazon Detective 以记录安全组的更改。指定一个 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 日志组来存储配置历史记录。创建一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列，用于通知配置更改。将 SysOps 管理员的电子邮件地址订阅到 SQS 队列。
