question_zh: 一家公司拥有一个公共网页应用程序，在当地电视广告播出后，流量会迅速增加。该应用程序运行在Amazon EC2实例上，这些实例属于一个自动扩展组。自动扩展组无法跟上广告播出后的流量激增。公司在流量高峰时常常需要扩展到100个EC2实例。由于每个实例的引导过程会创建机器特定的数据缓存，实例的启动时间较长。广告何时在电视上播出尚不确定。SysOps管理员必须实施一种解决方案，以确保应用程序在流量激增期间能够正常运行。哪种方案可以满足这些要求？
A_zh: 创建一个预热池。保持足够的实例处于已停止状态，以满足增加的需求。
B_zh: 启动100个实例。允许引导过程完成。在停止实例之前，将这些数据存储在实例存储卷上。
C_zh: 在扩缩策略中增加实例预热时间的值
D_zh: 对自动伸缩组使用预测性扩展。
question_zh_zh: 一家公司拥有一个公共网页应用程序，在当地电视广告播出后，流量会迅速增加。该应用程序运行在Amazon EC2实例上，这些实例属于一个自动扩展组。自动扩展组无法跟上广告播出后的流量激增。公司在流量高峰时常常需要扩展到100个EC2实例。由于每个实例的引导过程会创建机器特定的数据缓存，实例的启动时间较长。广告何时在电视上播出尚不确定。SysOps管理员必须实施一种解决方案，以确保应用程序在流量激增期间能够正常运行。哪种方案可以满足这些要求？

question: A company hosts an internal application on Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The instances are in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group. Employees use the application to provide product prices to potential customers. The Auto Scaling group is configured with a dynamic scaling policy and tracks average CPU utilization of the instances.  Employees have noticed that sometimes the application becomes slow or unresponsive. A SysOps administrator finds that some instances are experiencing a high CPU load. The Auto Scaling group cannot scale out because the company is reaching the EC2 instance service quota.  The SysOps administrator needs to implement a solution that provides a notification when the company reaches 70% or more of the EC2 instance service quota.  Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient manner?
A: Create an AWS Lambda function that lists the EC2 instances, counts the EC2 instances, and compares the total number against the applied quota value by using the Service Quotas API. Configure the Lambda function to publish an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification if the quota utilization is equal to or greater than 70%. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke the Lambda function.
B: Create an AWS Lambda function that lists the EC2 instances, counts the EC2 instances, and compares the total number against the applied quota value by using the Amazon CloudWatch Metrics API. Configure the Lambda function to publish an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification if the quota utilization is equal to or greater than 70%. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke the Lambda function.
C: Use the Service Quotas console to create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm for the EC2 instances. Configure the alarm with quota utilization equal to or greater than 70%. Configure the alarm to publish an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification when the alarm enters ALARM state.
D: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm. Configure the alarm with a threshold of 70% for the CPUUtilization metric for the EC2 instances. Configure the alarm to publish an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification when the alarm enters ALARM state.
question_zh: 公司在应用程序负载均衡器（ALB）后面使用 Amazon EC2 按需实例托管内部应用程序。这些实例位于 Amazon EC2 自动伸缩组中。员工使用该应用程序向潜在客户提供产品价格。自动伸缩组配置了动态伸缩策略，并跟踪实例的平均 CPU 利用率。员工注意到有时应用程序变得缓慢或无响应。系统运维管理员发现一些实例的 CPU 负载很高。由于公司即将达到 EC2 实例服务配额，自动伸缩组无法扩展。系统运维管理员需要实施一种解决方案，在公司达到 EC2 实例服务配额的70%或以上时提供通知。哪种解决方案以最具操作效率的方式满足这些需求？
A_zh: 创建一个AWS Lambda函数，用于列出EC2实例、统计EC2实例数量，并通过使用Service Quotas API将总数与已申请的配额值进行比较。如果配额使用率达到或超过70%，则配置该Lambda函数发布一条Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）通知。创建一个Amazon EventBridge规则以调用该Lambda函数。
B_zh: 创建一个AWS Lambda函数，用于列出EC2实例、统计EC2实例数量，并通过使用Amazon CloudWatch指标API将总数与已申请的配额值进行比较。如果配额使用率达到或超过70%，则配置该Lambda函数发布一条Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）通知。创建一个Amazon EventBridge规则以调用该Lambda函数。
C_zh: 使用服务配额控制台为EC2实例创建一个Amazon CloudWatch警报。将警报配置为配额利用率等于或大于70%。当警报进入“警报”状态时，配置警报发布一条Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）通知。
D_zh: 创建一个Amazon CloudWatch警报。将该警报的阈值设置为EC2实例的CPU利用率指标的70%。当警报进入“告警”状态时，配置该警报以发布一条Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）通知。
question_zh_zh: 公司在应用程序负载均衡器（ALB）后面使用 Amazon EC2 按需实例托管内部应用程序。这些实例位于 Amazon EC2 自动伸缩组中。员工使用该应用程序向潜在客户提供产品价格。自动伸缩组配置了动态伸缩策略，并跟踪实例的平均 CPU 利用率。员工注意到有时应用程序变得缓慢或无响应。系统运维管理员发现一些实例的 CPU 负载很高。由于公司即将达到 EC2 实例服务配额，自动伸缩组无法扩展。系统运维管理员需要实施一种解决方案，在公司达到 EC2 实例服务配额的70%或以上时提供通知。哪种解决方案以最具操作效率的方式满足这些需求？

question: A SysOps administrator needs to update an AWS account name.  What should the SysOps administrator do to accomplish this goal?
A: Add the AdministratorAccess policy to the SysOps administrator��s IAM user.
B: Add the AWS_ConfigureRole policy to the SysOps administrator��s IAM user.
C: Change the AWS account name through the AWS Trusted Advisor interface.
D: Sign in as the AWS account root user to make the change.
question_zh: SysOps 管理员需要更新 AWS 账户名称。SysOps 管理员应采取什么措施来实现这一目标？
A_zh: 将AdministratorAccess策略添加到SysOps管理员的IAM用户中。
B_zh: 将 AWS_ConfigureRole 策略添加到 SysOps 管理员的 IAM 用户中。
C_zh: 通过 AWS Trusted Advisor 界面更改 AWS 账户名称。
D_zh: 以AWS账户根用户身份登录以进行更改。
question_zh_zh: SysOps 管理员需要更新 AWS 账户名称。SysOps 管理员应采取什么措施来实现这一目标？

question: A team of developers is using several Amazon S3 buckets as centralized repositories. Users across the world upload large sets of files to these repositories. The development team's applications later process these files.  A SysOps administrator sets up a new S3 bucket, DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET, to support a new workload, The rew S3 bucket also receives regular uploads cf large sets of files from users worldwide. When the new S3 bucket is put into production, the upload performance from certain geographic areas is lower than the upload performance that the existing $3 buckets provide  What should the SysOps administrator do to remediate this issue?
A: Provision an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster for the new S3 bucket. Provide the developers with the configuration endpoint of the cluster for use in their API calls
B: Add the new S3 bucket to a new Amazon CloudFront distribution. Provide the developers with the domain name of the new distribution for use in their API calls.
C: Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration for the new S3 bucket. Verify that the developers are using the DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET.s3-accelerate.amazonaws.com endpoint name in their API calls.
D: Use S3 multipart upload for the new S3 bucket. Verify that the developers are using Region-specific S3 endpoint names such as DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKETS3, [Region] amazonaws.com in their API calls.
question_zh: 一支开发团队使用多个Amazon S3存储桶作为集中存储库。全球的用户将大量文件上传到这些存储库。开发团队的应用程序随后处理这些文件。一名SysOps管理员设置了一个新的S3存储桶，名为DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET，以支持新的工作负载。这个新的S3存储桶也会定期接收来自全球用户的大量文件上传。当新S3存储桶投入生产后，某些地区的上传性能低于现有的三个存储桶提供的性能。SysOps管理员应采取什么措施来解决这个问题？
A_zh: 为新的S3存储桶配置一个Amazon ElastiCache for Redis集群。向开发人员提供该集群的配置端点，以便在API调用中使用。
B_zh: 将新的S3存储桶添加到新的Amazon CloudFront分发中。提供给开发人员新分发的域名，以便在API调用中使用。
C_zh: 为新的S3存储桶启用S3传输加速。确认开发人员在API调用中使用的是DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET.s3-accelerate.amazonaws.com端点名称。
D_zh: 对新建的S3存储桶使用S3多部分上传。确保开发人员在API调用中使用区域特定的S3端点名称，例如DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKETS3、[Region] amazonaws.com。
question_zh_zh: SysOps管理员应考虑启用S3的传输加速功能，以提高全球上传性能。此外，还可以优化存储桶的区域设置，选择更接近用户的区域，或使用内容分发网络（CDN）来改善上传速度。

question: A SysOps administrator wants to use AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager to automate the process of patching Amazon EC2 Windows instances. The SysOps administrator wants to ensure that patches are auto-approved 2 days after the release date for development instances. Patches also must be auto-approved 5 days after the release date for production instances. Maintenance must occur only during a 2-hour window for all instances.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Use tags to identify development instances and production instances. In Patch Manager, create two patch groups and one patch baseline. Add an auto-approval delay to each patch group. Create a single maintenance window.
B: Use tags to identify development instances and production instances. In Patch Manager, create two patch groups and two patch baselines. Specify an auto-approval delay in each of the patch baselines. Create a single maintenance window.
C: Use tags to identity development instances and production instances. In Patch Manager, create two patch groups and one patch baseline, Create two separate maintenance windows, each with an auto-approval delay.
D: Use tags to identify development instances. In Patch Manager, create one patch group and one patch baseline. Specify auto-approval delays in the patch baseline, Add development instances to the new patch group. Use predefined Patch Manager patch baselines for all remaining instances. Create a single maintenance window.
question_zh: 一名SysOps管理员希望使用AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager自动化修补Amazon EC2 Windows实例的流程。该管理员希望确保开发实例的补丁在发布后2天自动批准，生产实例的补丁在发布后5天自动批准。所有实例的维护只能在一个持续2小时的时间窗口内进行。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？
A_zh: 使用标签来识别开发实例和生产实例。在补丁管理器中，创建两个补丁组和一个补丁基线。为每个补丁组添加自动批准延迟。创建一个维护窗口。
B_zh: 使用标签来区分开发实例和生产实例。在补丁管理器中，创建两个补丁组和两个补丁基线。在每个补丁基线中指定自动批准延迟。创建一个维护窗口。
C_zh: 使用标签来识别开发实例和生产实例。在补丁管理器中，创建两个补丁组和一个补丁基线。创建两个单独的维护窗口，每个都设置自动批准延迟。
D_zh: 使用标签来标识开发实例。在补丁管理器中，创建一个补丁组和一个补丁基线。在补丁基线中指定自动批准延迟，将开发实例添加到新的补丁组中。对所有剩余实例使用预定义的补丁管理器补丁基线。创建一个维护窗口。
question_zh_zh: 一种解决方案是在AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager中配置不同的补丁批准规则，针对开发和生产实例设置不同的自动批准时间（开发实例为2天，生产实例为5天），并将所有实例的维护窗口设置为连续的2小时。

question: A SysOps administrator must analyze Amazon CloudWatch logs across 10 AWS Lambda functions for historical errors. The logs are in JSON format and are stored in Amazon S3. Errors sometimes do not appear in the same field, but all errors begin with the same string prefix.  What is the MOST operationally efficient way for the SysOps administrator to analyze the log files?
A: Use S3 Select to write a query to search for errors. Run the query across all log groups of interest.
B: Create an AWS Glue processing job to index the logs of interest. Run a query in Amazon Athena to search for errors.
C: Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights to write a query to search for errors. Run the query across all log groups of interest.
D: Use Amazon CloudWatch Contributor Insights to create a rule. Apply the rule across all log groups of interest.
question_zh: SysOps 管理员必须分析10个AWS Lambda函数的Amazon CloudWatch日志，以查找历史错误。日志采用JSON格式，存储在Amazon S3中。错误有时不会出现在相同的字段中，但所有错误都以相同的字符串前缀开头。SysOps管理员分析日志文件的最具操作效率的方法是什么？
A_zh: 使用S3 Select编写查询以搜索错误。在所有感兴趣的日志组中运行该查询。
B_zh: 创建一个AWS Glue处理作业以索引感兴趣的日志。在Amazon Athena中运行查询以搜索错误。
C_zh: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights 编写查询以搜索错误。在所有感兴趣的日志组中运行该查询。
D_zh: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch Contributor Insights 创建规则。将该规则应用于所有感兴趣的日志组。
question_zh_zh: SysOps管理员分析日志文件的最具操作效率的方法是使用Amazon Athena对存储在Amazon S3中的JSON格式日志进行查询。通过在日志中定义一个通用的字符串前缀作为错误的标识，可以编写SQL查询语句筛选出所有以该前缀开头的错误记录，从而快速定位和分析历史错误。

question: A company has a policy that all Amazon EC2 instance logs must be published to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. A SysOps administrator is troubleshooting an EC2 instance that is running Amazon Linux 2. The EC2 instance is not publishing logs to CloudWatch Logs. The Amazon CloudWatch agent is running on the EC2 instance, and the agent configuration file is correct.  What should the SysOps administrator do to resolve the issue?
A: Configure the AWS CLI on the EC2 instance. Create a cron job that calls the PutLogEvents API operation to push the log files to CloudWatch every 5 minutes.
B: Inspect the retention period of the CloudWatch Logs log group. Ensure that the retention period is set to a value that is greater than 1 day.
C: Set up an Amazon Kinesis data stream that is running in the same AWS Region as the EC2 instance. Configure the CloudWatch agent on the EC2 instance to send CloudWatch events to the data stream.
D: Ensure that the IAM role that is attached to the EC2 instance has permissions in CloudWatch Logs for the CreateLogGroup, CreateLogStream, PutLogEvents, and DescribeLogStreams actions.
question_zh: 公司有一项政策，所有的 Amazon EC2 实例日志必须发布到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs。一名 SysOps 管理员正在排查一台运行 Amazon Linux 2 的 EC2 实例。该实例未将日志发布到 CloudWatch Logs。EC2 实例上正在运行 Amazon CloudWatch 代理，且代理配置文件是正确的。SysOps 管理员应采取什么措施以解决该问题？
A_zh: 在EC2实例上配置AWS CLI。创建一个cron任务，每隔5分钟调用PutLogEvents API操作，将日志文件推送到CloudWatch。
B_zh: 检查 CloudWatch Logs 日志组的保留期限。确保保留期限设置为大于1天的值。
C_zh: 设置一个在与EC2实例相同AWS区域运行的Amazon Kinesis数据流。在EC2实例上配置CloudWatch代理，将CloudWatch事件发送到该数据流。
D_zh: 确保附加到EC2实例的IAM角色具有在CloudWatch Logs中执行CreateLogGroup、CreateLogStream、PutLogEvents和DescribeLogStreams操作的权限。
question_zh_zh: 该管理员应检查 CloudWatch 代理的日志，确认代理是否正常运行以及是否有错误信息。同时，验证代理配置文件中的日志流和日志组设置是否正确，确保实例的日志路径已被正确配置并包含在代理配置中。如果配置正确但问题仍然存在，可以尝试重新启动 CloudWatch 代理以确保其正常运行。

question: A company runs a workload on an Amazon EC2 instance. The workload needs a temporary cache that contains data that changes frequently. The workload does not need to retain the cache across instance restarts.  Which storage option will provide the HIGHEST performance for the cache?
A: General Purpose SSD (gp3) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume
B: Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume
C: Throughput Optimized HDD (st1) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume
D: EC2 instance store
question_zh: 哪种存储选项能为缓存提供最高性能？
A_zh: 通用型SSD（gp3）亚马逊弹性块存储（Amazon EBS）卷
B_zh: 预配置 IOPS SSD（io2）亚马逊弹性块存储（Amazon EBS）卷
C_zh: 吞吐量优化的硬盘驱动器（st1）亚马逊弹性块存储（Amazon EBS）卷
D_zh: EC2实例存储
question_zh_zh: 哪种存储选项能为缓存提供最高性能？

question: A company runs multiple workloads across an organization in AWS Organizations. The company's finance team needs detailed dashboards to track cost changes and provide detailed cost metrics. The finance team needs to track trends as granular as every hour.  What should a SysOps administrator do to meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?
A: Generate Amazon CloudWatch dashboards by using CloudWatch insights and AWS Cost Explorer data.
B: Generate an AWS Cost and Usage Report. Store the report in Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena to query the data. Use Amazon QuickSight to develop dashbosrds based on the data in the AWS Cost and Usage Report.
C: Create an AWS Lambda function that runs once a day and assumes a role in every account in the organization. Configure the Lambda function to read AWS Cost Explorer data in each account and to store the cost data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon Athena to query the data. Use Amazon QuickSight to display the data in dashboards.
D: Create an IAM user for the finance team. Grant permissions to the IAM user to view AWS Cost Explorer data and billing data in the management account.
question_zh: 一家公司在AWS组织中运行多个工作负载。公司的财务团队需要详细的仪表盘来跟踪成本变化并提供详细的成本指标。财务团队需要以每小时为单位跟踪趋势。SysOps管理员应采取什么措施以最具操作效率的方式满足这些需求？
A_zh: 使用 CloudWatch Insights 和 AWS 成本管理器数据生成 Amazon CloudWatch 仪表板。
B_zh: 生成一份AWS成本与使用情况报告。将报告存储在Amazon S3中。使用Amazon Athena对数据进行查询。使用Amazon QuickSight根据AWS成本与使用情况报告中的数据开发仪表板。
C_zh: 创建一个每天运行一次的AWS Lambda函数，并在组织中的每个账户中承担角色。配置该Lambda函数以读取每个账户中的AWS Cost Explorer数据，并将成本数据存储在一个Amazon S3存储桶中。使用Amazon Athena对数据进行查询。使用Amazon QuickSight在仪表盘中显示数据。
D_zh: 为财务团队创建一个IAM用户。授予该IAM用户查看AWS成本管理器数据和账单数据的权限。
question_zh_zh: SysOps管理员应使用AWS Cost Explorer或AWS Cost and Usage Report（CUR）创建定制的仪表盘，设置每小时的成本追踪和详细指标，并利用自动化工具（如AWS Lambda和CloudWatch）实现数据的自动更新和通知，以最高效的方式满足财务团队的需求。

question: A company has a core application that must run 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. The application uses Amazon EC2. AWS Fargate, and AWS Lambda. The company uses a combination of operating systems across different AWS Regions.  The company needs to maximize cost savings while committing to a pricing model that offers flexibility to make changes.  What should the company do to meet these requirements?
A: Purchase a Compute Savings Plan that is based on Savings Plans recommendations
B: Purchase an EC2 Instance Savings Plan that covers the EC2 instance types and the Fargate and Lambda vCPU equivalents.
C: Purchase a Reserved Instance for the instance types, operating systems, Region, and tenancy,
D: Use EC2 Spot Instances that match the type and size of existing instances that run in each Region.
question_zh: 公司拥有一个必须全天候运行的核心应用程序，每周7天。该应用程序使用Amazon EC2、AWS Fargate和AWS Lambda。公司在不同的AWS区域使用多种操作系统。公司需要在最大限度节省成本的同时，选择一种具有灵活性以便进行调整的定价模型。公司应采取什么措施以满足这些要求？
A_zh: 购买基于节省计划建议的计算节省计划
B_zh: 购买涵盖EC2实例类型以及Fargate和Lambda vCPU等效的EC2实例节省计划。
C_zh: 为实例类型、操作系统、区域和租赁方式购买预留实例
D_zh: 使用与每个区域中现有实例类型和大小相匹配的EC2竞价实例。
question_zh_zh: 公司应采用按需定价和预留实例相结合的混合定价模型，以实现成本节省和灵活性。同时，利用AWS的区域分布优化资源部署，采用自动扩展和弹性负载均衡以确保核心应用程序的全天候运行。

question: A company��s architecture team must receive immediate email notification whenever new Amazon EC2 instances are launched in the company's main AWS production account.  ��What should a SysOps administrator do to meet this requirement?
A: Create a user data script that sends an email message through a smart host connector. Include the architecture team's email address in the user data script as the recipient. Ensure that all new EC2 instances include the user data script as part of a standardized build process.
B: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic and a subscription that uses the email protocol. Enter the architecture team's email address as the subscriber. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that reacts when EC2 instances are launched. Specify the SNS topic as the rule's target.
C: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue and a subscription that uses the email protocol. Enter the architecture team's email address as the subscriber. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that reacts when EC2 instances are launched. Specify the SQS queue as the rule's target.
D: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Configure AWS Systems Manager to publish EC2 events to the SNS topic. Create an AWS Lambda function to poll the SNS topic. Configure the Lambda function to send any messages to the architecture team's email address.
question_zh: 一家公司架构团队必须在公司主要的AWS生产账户中启动新的Amazon EC2实例时立即收到电子邮件通知。SysOps管理员应采取什么措施以满足此要求？
A_zh: 创建一个用户数据脚本，通过智能主机连接器发送电子邮件消息。在用户数据脚本中包含架构团队的电子邮件地址作为收件人。确保所有新的EC2实例在标准化构建过程中都包含该用户数据脚本。
B_zh: 创建一个Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）主题和一个使用电子邮件协议的订阅。将架构团队的电子邮件地址作为订阅者。创建一个在EC2实例启动时触发的Amazon EventBridge规则。将SNS主题指定为该规则的目标。
C_zh: 创建一个Amazon Simple Queue Service（Amazon SQS）队列和一个使用电子邮件协议的订阅。将架构团队的电子邮件地址作为订阅者。创建一个在EC2实例启动时触发的Amazon EventBridge规则。将SQS队列指定为该规则的目标。
D_zh: 创建一个Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）主题。配置AWS Systems Manager，将EC2事件发布到该SNS主题。创建一个AWS Lambda函数，用于轮询该SNS主题。将Lambda函数配置为将任何消息发送到架构团队的电子邮件地址。
question_zh_zh: SysOps管理员应配置CloudWatch警报或使用AWS CloudWatch Events结合Lambda函数，在在公司主要的AWS生产账户中启动新的Amazon EC2实例时立即发送电子邮件通知。

question: A SysOps administrator manages an AWS account where developers run CPU-intensive tasks on Amazon EC2 instances. The tasks can take several days to finish running and sometimes need to be repeated several times. The developers often forget to terminate the instances when the tasks are complete.  The SysOps administrator needs to implement a solution to monitor EC2 CPU utilization and automatically terminate underutilized instances.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Configure an Amazon GuardDuty finding that is based on EC2 CPU utilization. Associate an AWS Lambda function with the GuardDuty finding to terminate any instances that are identified as idle.
B: Configure an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to receive EC2 utilization messages from the AWS Health Dashboard. Create an AWS Lambda function. Subscribe the Lambda function to the SNS topic. Use the ec2.stop_instances operation to terminate idle instances.
C: Configure a Low Utilization Amazon EC2 Instances check in AWS Trusted Advisor to publish status changes to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Create an AWS Lambda function. Subscribe the Lambda function to the SNS topic. Use the ec2.stop_instances operation to terminate idle instances.
D: Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule for the Low Utilization Amazon EC2 Instances check in AWS Trusted Advisor. Select the EC2 Terminatelnstances API call as the target.
question_zh: SysOps 管理员管理一个 AWS 账户，开发人员在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行 CPU 密集型任务。这些任务可能需要几天时间才能完成，有时还需要多次重复。开发人员经常忘记在任务完成后终止实例。SysOps 管理员需要实施一个解决方案，监控 EC2 的 CPU 利用率，并自动终止利用率低的实例。哪种解决方案可以满足这些需求？
A_zh: 配置一个基于EC2 CPU利用率的Amazon GuardDuty发现。将一个AWS Lambda函数与该GuardDuty发现关联，以终止被识别为空闲的实例。
B_zh: 配置一个Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）主题，以接收来自AWS健康仪表板的EC2利用率消息。创建一个AWS Lambda函数。将Lambda函数订阅到该SNS主题。使用ec2.stop_instances操作终止空闲实例。
C_zh: 在AWS Trusted Advisor中配置低利用率的Amazon EC2实例检查，以将状态变化发布到Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）主题。创建一个AWS Lambda函数。将Lambda函数订阅到SNS主题。使用ec2.stop_instances操作终止空闲实例。
D_zh: 为AWS Trusted Advisor中的低利用率Amazon EC2实例检查配置一个Amazon EventBridge规则。选择EC2 TerminateInstances API调用作为目标。
question_zh_zh: SysOps 管理员管理一个 AWS 账户，开发人员在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行 CPU 密集型任务。这些任务可能需要几天时间才能完成，有时还需要多次重复。开发人员经常忘记在任务完成后终止实例。SysOps 管理员需要实施一个解决方案，监控 EC2 的 CPU 利用率，并自动终止利用率低的实例。哪种解决方案可以满足这些需求？

question: A company has several business units that want to use Amazon EC2. The company wants to require all business units to provision their EC2 instances by using only approved EC2 instance configurations.  What should a SysOps administrator do to implement this requirement?
A: Create an EC2 instance launch configuration. Allow the business units to launch EC2 instances by specifying this launch configuration in the AWS Management Console.
B: Develop an IAM policy that limits the business units to provision EC2 instances only. Instruct the business units to launch instances by using an AWS CloudFormation template.
C: Publish a product and launch constraint role for EC2 instances by using AWS Service Catalog. Allow the business units to perform actions in AWS Service Catalog only.
D: Share an AWS CloudFormation template with the business units. Instruct the business units to pass a role to AWS CloudFormation to allow the service to manage EC2 instances.
question_zh: 一家公司有多个业务部门希望使用亚马逊EC2。公司希望所有业务部门都必须使用经过批准的EC2实例配置来配置他们的EC2实例。SysOps管理员应采取什么措施来实现这一要求？
A_zh: 创建一个EC2实例启动配置。允许业务部门通过在AWS管理控制台中指定此启动配置来启动EC2实例。
B_zh: 制定一项身份与访问管理（IAM）策略，限制业务部门仅能配置EC2实例。指示业务部门使用AWS CloudFormation模板来启动实例。
C_zh: 通过使用AWS Service Catalog发布产品并设置EC2实例的部署限制角色。允许业务部门仅在AWS Service Catalog中执行操作。
D_zh: 与业务部门共享一份AWS CloudFormation模板。指示业务部门将角色传递给AWS CloudFormation，以允许该服务管理EC2实例。
question_zh_zh: SysOps管理员应实施基于配置模板或启动模板的自动化部署策略，确保所有业务部门在创建EC2实例时必须使用经过批准的配置。此外，可以使用AWS Config进行合规性监控，自动检测未符合配置的实例，并采取相应的纠正措施。

question: A SysOps administrator needs to secure the credentials for an Amazon RDS database that is created by an AWS CloudFormation template. The solution must encrypt the credentials and must support automatic rotation.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Create an AWS::SecretsManager::Secret resource in the CloudF ormation template. Reference the credentials in the AWS::RDS::DBInstance resource by using the resolve:secretsmanager dynamic reference.
B: Create an AWS::SecretsManager::Secret resource in the CloudFormation template. Reference the credentials in the AWS::RDS::DBInstance resource by using the resolve:ssm-secure dynamic reference.
C: Create an AWS::SSM::Parameter resource in he CloudFormation template. Reference the credentias in the AWS::RDS::DBInstance resource by using the resolve:ssm dynamic reference.
D: Create parameters for the database credentials in the CloudFormation template. Use the Ref intrinsic function to provide the credentials to the AWS::RDS::DBInstance resource.
question_zh: SysOps 管理员需要保护由 AWS CloudFormation 模板创建的 Amazon RDS 数据库的凭证。解决方案必须对凭证进行加密，并支持自动轮换。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？
A_zh: 在CloudFormation模板中创建一个AWS::SecretsManager::Secret资源。通过使用resolve:secretsmanager动态引用，在AWS::RDS::DBInstance资源中引用该凭据。
B_zh: 在CloudFormation模板中创建一个AWS::SecretsManager::Secret资源。通过使用resolve:ssm-secure动态引用，在AWS::RDS::DBInstance资源中引用凭据。
C_zh: 在 CloudFormation 模板中创建一个 AWS::SSM::Parameter 资源。通过使用 resolve:ssm 动态引用，在 AWS::RDS::DBInstance 资源中引用凭证。
D_zh: 在CloudFormation模板中为数据库凭证创建参数。使用Ref内置函数将凭证提供给AWS::RDS::DBInstance资源。
question_zh_zh: SysOps 管理员需要保护由 AWS CloudFormation 模板创建的 Amazon RDS 数据库的凭证。解决方案必须对凭证进行加密，并支持自动轮换。哪种方案能够满足这些要求？

question: A company wants to track its expenditures for Amazon EC2 and Amazon RDS within AWS. The company decides to implement more rigorous tagging requirements for resources in its AWS accounts. A SysOps administrator needs to identify all noncompliant resources.  What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that meets this requirement?
A: Create a rule in Amazon EventBridge that invokes a custom AWS Lambda function that will evaluate all created or updated resources for the specified tags.
B: Create a rule in AWS Config that invokes a custom AWS Lambda function that will evaluate all resources for the specified tags.
C: Create a rule in AWS Config with the required-tags managed rule to evaluate all resources for the specified tags.
D: Create a rule in Amazon EventBridge with a managed rule to evaluate all created or updated resources for the specified tags.
question_zh: 一家公司希望在AWS中跟踪其Amazon EC2和Amazon RDS的支出。该公司决定对其AWS账户中的资源实施更严格的标签要求。一名SysOps管理员需要识别所有不符合要求的资源。满足此需求的最具操作效率的解决方案是什么？
A_zh: 在 Amazon EventBridge 中创建一条规则，调用自定义的 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数将评估所有已创建或更新的资源是否具有指定的标签。
B_zh: 在AWS Config中创建一条规则，调用自定义的AWS Lambda函数，该函数将评估所有资源是否具有指定的标签。
C_zh: 在AWS Config中创建一个使用required-tags托管规则的规则，以评估所有资源是否具有指定的标签。
D_zh: 在 Amazon EventBridge 中创建一个托管规则，用于评估所有创建或更新的资源是否具有指定的标签。
question_zh_zh: 最具操作效率的解决方案是使用AWS资源标签策略（Tag Policies）结合AWS Config进行合规性检查。通过定义标签策略，强制执行标签要求，然后利用AWS Config定期评估资源的标签合规性，识别所有不符合要求的资源。

question: A company creates a new Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. To help manage costs, the company configures the storage capacity for the file system with minimal room for growth.  The company creates an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic in the same AWS account whore the file system resides. The company subscribes a SysOps administrator's email address to the SNS topic. The SysOps administrator needs to receive email notification when the file system has less than 100 GB of space available.  Which combination of steps should the SysOps administrator take to meet this requirement? (Choose two.)
A: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule for when the FreeStorageCapacity metric is less than or equal to 100,000,000,000 bytes (100 GB).
B: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm for when the FreeStorageCapacity metric is less than or equal to 100,000,000,000 bytes (100 GB).
C: Create an AWS Lambda function that will run when the Amazon CloudWatch alarm enters ALARM state. Configure the Lambda function to publish to the SNS topic.
D: Configure the Amazon EventBridge rule's alarm action to publish to the SNS topic when the rule enters ALARM state.
E: Configure the Amazon CloudWatch alarm action to publish to the SNS topic when the alarm enters ALARM state.
question_zh: 一家公司创建了一个新的Amazon FSx for Windows文件服务器文件系统。为了帮助管理成本，该公司将文件系统的存储容量配置为增长空间最小。该公司在与文件系统所在的相同AWS账户中创建了一个Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）主题。公司将一位SysOps管理员的电子邮件地址订阅到该SNS主题。当文件系统的可用空间少于100 GB时，SysOps管理员需要收到电子邮件通知。SysOps管理员应采取哪些步骤以满足此要求？（选择两个）
A_zh: 创建一个当FreeStorageCapacity指标小于或等于100,000,000,000字节（100 GB）时的Amazon EventBridge规则。
B_zh: 创建一个当FreeStorageCapacity指标小于或等于100,000,000,000字节（100 GB）时的Amazon CloudWatch警报。
C_zh: 创建一个AWS Lambda函数，当Amazon CloudWatch警报进入警报状态时触发。将该Lambda函数配置为发布到SNS主题。
D_zh: 将 Amazon EventBridge 规则的告警操作配置为在规则进入 ALARM 状态时发布到 SNS 主题。
E_zh: 将 Amazon CloudWatch 警报操作配置为在警报进入“告警”状态时发布到 SNS 主题。
question_zh_zh:
公司应采取以下两个步骤以满足此要求：
1. 配置Amazon CloudWatch警报，监控文件系统的剩余存储空间，并在空间少于100 GB时触发。
2. 将该CloudWatch警报的通知目标设置为已订阅的SNS主题，以便SysOps管理员能收到电子邮件通知。

question: A company decides to stop non-production Amazon EC2 instances during the EC2 instances. The company's IT manager must receive notification in near real time whenever an EC2 instance that has an environment type tag value of non-production is started during the night.  Which solution will meet this requirement with the MOST operational efficiency?
A: Configure an AWS Lambda function with an SMTP client library. Subscribe the Lambda function to the AWS Health Dashboard to receive notification whenever an EC2 instance is in the running state. Configure the Lambda function to use Amazon Pinpoint to send email notifications to the IT manager. Deploy a second Lambda function to throttle calls from the first Lambda function during the daytime.
B: Deploy an AWS Lambda function that queries the Amazon EC2 API to determine the state of each EC2 instance. Use the EC2 instance scheduler to configure the Lambda function to run every minute during the night and to send an email notification to the IT manager for each non-production EC2 instance that is in the running state.
C: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that includes the EC2 Instance State-change Notification event type. Filter the event to capture only the running state. Create an AWS Lambda function as a target of the rule. Configure the Lambda function to check the current time and the EC2 instances�� tags to determine the environment type. Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic as a target of the Lambda function for notifications. Subscribe the IT manager's email address to the SNS topic.
D: Store the EC2 instance metadata, including the environment type, in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Deploy a custom application to an EC2 instance. Configure the custom application to poll the DynamoDB data every minute during the night and to query the Amazon EC2 API to determine the state of each instance. Additionally, configure the custom application to send an email notification to the IT manager for each non-production EC2 instance that is in the running state.
question_zh: 公司决定在EC2实例运行期间停止非生产环境的Amazon EC2实例。公司的IT经理必须在夜间任何具有环境类型标签值为“非生产”的EC2实例启动时，几乎实时收到通知。哪种解决方案能以最高的运营效率满足此需求？
A_zh: 配置一个带有SMTP客户端库的AWS Lambda函数。将该Lambda函数订阅到AWS健康仪表板，以在EC2实例处于运行状态时接收通知。配置该Lambda函数使用Amazon Pinpoint向IT经理发送电子邮件通知。在白天部署第二个Lambda函数，以限制第一个Lambda函数的调用频率。
B_zh: 部署一个AWS Lambda函数，查询Amazon EC2 API以确定每个EC2实例的状态。使用EC2实例调度器将该Lambda函数配置为在夜间每分钟运行一次，并对每个处于运行状态的非生产EC2实例向IT经理发送电子邮件通知。
C_zh: 创建一个包含EC2实例状态变更通知事件类型的Amazon EventBridge规则。筛选事件，只捕获运行状态。将AWS Lambda函数作为该规则的目标。配置Lambda函数，检查当前时间和EC2实例的标签，以确定环境类型。创建一个Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）主题，作为Lambda函数的通知目标。将IT经理的电子邮件地址订阅到该SNS主题。
D_zh: 将EC2实例元数据（包括环境类型）存储在Amazon DynamoDB表中。在EC2实例上部署自定义应用程序。配置自定义应用程序在夜间每分钟轮询一次DynamoDB数据，并查询Amazon EC2 API以确定每个实例的状态。此外，配置自定义应用程序在每个处于运行状态的非生产EC2实例上向IT经理发送电子邮件通知。
question_zh_zh: 公司决定在EC2实例运行期间停止非生产环境的Amazon EC2实例。公司的IT经理必须在夜间任何具有环境类型标签值为“非生产”的EC2实例启动时，几乎实时收到通知。哪种解决方案能以最高的运营效率满足此需求？

question: A company��s SysOps administrator manages a fleet of Windows Amazon EC2 instances that run in a single AWS account. The instances have a tag that includes a key of ��OS" and a value of "Windows." The company uses AWS Systems Manager to patch the instances.  The company has installed the Amazon CloudWatch agent on the instances, but the configuration is inconsistent. The SysOps administrator needs to reconfigure every instance to use the same predefined CloudWatch configuration.  Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
A: Store the CloudWatch agent configuration file in an Amazon S3 bucket.
B: Store the contents of the CloudWatch agent configuration file in Systems Manager OpsCenter.
C: Store the contents of the CloudWatch agent configuration file in Systems Manager Parameter Store.
D: Create a Systems Manager State Manager association to run the AmazonCloudWatch-ManageAgent Systems Manager Run Command document. Select Systems Manager as an optional configuration source. Target the instances based on tag values.
E: Create a Systems Manager State Manager association to run the AmazonCloudWatch-ManageAgent Systems Manager Run Command document. Configure the document to use the S3 bucket location as the configuration source. Target the instances based on tag value.
question_zh: 一家公司 的 SysOps 管理员管理一组在单一 AWS 账户中运行的 Windows Amazon EC2 实例。这些实例有一个标签，包含键为“OS”、值为“Windows”。公司使用 AWS Systems Manager 来对实例进行补丁。公司已在实例上安装了 Amazon CloudWatch 代理，但配置不一致。SysOps 管理员需要重新配置每个实例，使其使用相同的预定义 CloudWatch 配置。哪些步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两个）
A_zh: 将 CloudWatch 代理配置文件存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。
B_zh: 将CloudWatch代理配置文件的内容存储在Systems Manager的OpsCenter中。
C_zh: 将CloudWatch代理配置文件的内容存储在Systems Manager参数存储中。
D_zh: 创建一个系统管理器状态管理器关联，以运行 AmazonCloudWatch-ManageAgent 系统管理器运行命令文档。选择系统管理器作为可选配置源。根据标签值定位实例。
E_zh: 创建一个系统管理器状态管理器关联，以运行 AmazonCloudWatch-ManageAgent 系统管理器运行命令文档。将该文档配置为使用 S3 存储桶位置作为配置源。根据标签值定位实例。
question_zh_zh: 一家公司 的 SysOps 管理员管理一组在单一 AWS 账户中运行的 Windows Amazon EC2 实例。这些实例有一个标签，包含键为“OS”、值为“Windows”。公司使用 AWS Systems Manager 来对实例进行补丁。公司已在实例上安装了 Amazon CloudWatch 代理，但配置不一致。SysOps 管理员需要重新配置每个实例，使其使用相同的预定义 CloudWatch 配置。哪些步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两个）

question: A company is experiencing issues with legacy software running on Amazon EC2 instances. Errors occur when the total CPU utilization on the EC2 instances exceeds 80%. A short-term solution is required while the software is being rewritten. A SysOps administrator is tasked with creating a solution to restart the instances when the CPU utilization rises above 80%.  Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
A: Write a script that monitors the CPU utilization of the EC2 instances and reboots the instances when utilization exceeds 80%. Run the script as a cron job.
B: Add an Amazon CloudWatch alarm for CPU utilization and configure the alarm action to reboot the EC2 instances.
C: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule using the predefined patterns for CPU utilization of the EC2 instances. When utilization exceeds 80%, invoke an AWS Lambda function to restart the instances.
D: Add an Amazon CloudWatch alarm for CPU utilization and configure an AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook to reboot the EC2 instances when utilization exceeds 80%.
question_zh: 一家公司在运行旧版软件的Amazon EC2实例上遇到问题。当EC2实例的总CPU利用率超过80%时，会发生错误。在软件重写期间，需要一个短期解决方案。一名SysOps管理员负责创建一个在CPU利用率超过80%时重启实例的解决方案。哪种方案在操作负担最小的情况下满足这些要求？
A_zh: 编写一个脚本，监控EC2实例的CPU利用率，当利用率超过80%时重启实例。将该脚本作为cron作业运行。
B_zh: 添加一个用于CPU利用率的Amazon CloudWatch警报，并将警报操作配置为重启EC2实例。
C_zh: 使用预定义的模式为EC2实例的CPU利用率创建一个Amazon EventBridge规则。当利用率超过80%时，触发一个AWS Lambda函数以重启实例。
D_zh: 为CPU利用率添加一个Amazon CloudWatch警报，并配置一个AWS Systems Manager自动化运行手册，在利用率超过80%时重启EC2实例。
question_zh_zh: 一种方案是在EC2实例上设置CloudWatch警报，当CPU利用率超过80%时自动触发Lambda函数，该函数会重启实例。这种方法操作负担最小，自动化程度高。

question: A SysOps administrator launches an Amazon EC2 instance in a private subnet of a VPC. When the SysOps administrator attempts a curl command from the command line of the EC2 instance, the SysOps administrator cannot connect to https:www.example.com.  What should the SysOps administrator do to resolve this issue?
A: Ensure that there is an outbound security group for port 443 to 0.0.0.0/0.
B: Ensure that there is an inbound security group for port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0.
C: Ensure that there is an outbound network ACL for ephemeral ports 1024-66535 to 0.0.0.0/0.
D: Ensure that there is an outbound network ACL for port 80 to 0.0.0.0/0.
question_zh: SysOps管理员在VPC的私有子网中启动了一个Amazon EC2实例。当SysOps管理员尝试在EC2实例的命令行中使用curl命令时，无法连接到https://www.example.com。SysOps管理员应采取什么措施来解决此问题？
A_zh: 确保为端口 443 设置一个指向 0.0.0.0/0 的出站安全组。
B_zh: 确保存在一个允许来自0.0.0.0/0的端口443的入站安全组。
C_zh: 确保针对临时端口范围1024-66535到0.0.0.0/0的出站网络ACL已设置。
D_zh: 确保针对端口80到0.0.0.0/0的出站网络访问控制列表（ACL）已存在。
question_zh_zh: SysOps管理员应检查VPC的安全组和网络ACL设置，确保允许出站HTTPS（端口443）流量。此外，还应确认私有子网是否配置了适当的NAT网关或NAT实例，以便私有子网中的实例能够访问互联网。

question: A SysOps administrator needs to implement a backup strategy for Amazon EC2 resources and Amazon RDS resources. The backup strategy must meet the following retention requirements:  ? Daily backups: must be kept for 6 days ? Weekly backups: must be kept for 4 weeks: ? Monthly backups: must be kept for 11 months ? Yearly backups: must be kept for 7 years  Which backup strategy will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative effort?
A: Use Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager to create an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) snapshot policy. Create tags on each resource that needs to be backed up. Create multiple schedules according to the requirements within the policy. Set the appropriate frequency and retention period.
B: Use AWS Backup to create a new backup plan for each retention requirement with a backup frequency of daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly. Set the retention period to match the requirement. Create tags on each resource that needs to be backed up. Set up resource assignment by using the tags.
C: Create an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to use native tooling to take backups of file systems in Amazon EC2 and to make copies of databases in Amazon RDS. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke the Lambda function.
D: Use Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager to create an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) snapshot policy. Create tags on each resource that needs to be backed up. Set up resource assignment by using the tags. Create multiple schedules according to the requirements within the policy. Set the appropriate frequency and retention period. In Amazon RDS, activate automated backups on the required DB instances.
question_zh:
SysOps 管理员需要为 Amazon EC2 资源和 Amazon RDS 资源实施备份策略。该备份策略必须满足以下保留要求：
- 每日备份：必须保存6天
- 每周备份：必须保存4周
- 每月备份：必须保存11个月
- 每年备份：必须保存7年
哪种备份策略能以最少的管理工作量满足这些要求？
A_zh: 使用亚马逊数据生命周期管理器创建亚马逊弹性块存储（Amazon EBS）快照策略。在每个需要备份的资源上创建标签。根据策略中的要求创建多个计划。设置适当的频率和保留期限。
B_zh: 使用AWS Backup为每个保留需求创建一个新的备份计划，备份频率可以是每日、每周、每月或每年。将保留期设置为符合需求的时间。为每个需要备份的资源创建标签。通过使用标签设置资源分配。
C_zh: 创建一个AWS Lambda函数。编写Lambda函数，使用原生工具对Amazon EC2中的文件系统进行备份，并复制Amazon RDS中的数据库。创建一个Amazon EventBridge规则以调用该Lambda函数。
D_zh: 使用Amazon数据生命周期管理器创建Amazon弹性块存储（Amazon EBS）快照策略。在每个需要备份的资源上创建标签。通过使用标签设置资源分配。根据策略中的要求创建多个计划。设置合适的频率和保留期限。在Amazon RDS中，激活所需数据库实例的自动备份。
question_zh_zh:
哪种备份策略能够以最少的管理工作量满足以下要求？
- 每日备份：必须保存6天
- 每周备份：必须保存4周
- 每月备份：必须保存11个月
- 每年备份：必须保存7年

question: An application team uses an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB cluster with one Aurora Replica. The application team notices that the application read performance degrades when user connections exceed 200. The number of user connections is typically consistent around 180, with occasional sudden increases above 200 connections. The application team wants the application to automatically scale as user demand increases or decreases.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Migrate to a new Aurora multi-master DB cluster. Modify the application database connection string.
B: Modify the DB cluster by changing to serverless mode whenever user connections exceed 200.
C: Create an auto scaling policy with a target metric of 195 DatabaseConnections.
D: Modify the DB cluster by increasing the Aurora Replica instance size.
question_zh: 一个应用团队使用一个带有一个Aurora副本的Amazon Aurora MySQL数据库集群。当用户连接数超过200时，应用的读取性能会下降。用户连接数通常稳定在180左右，偶尔会突然增加超过200个连接。应用团队希望应用能够在用户需求增加或减少时自动扩展。哪种解决方案可以满足这些需求？
A_zh: 迁移到新的 Aurora 多主数据库集群。修改应用程序的数据库连接字符串。
B_zh: 当用户连接数超过200时，将数据库集群切换为无服务器模式。
C_zh: 创建一个以195个数据库连接数为目标指标的自动扩展策略。
D_zh: 通过增加Aurora副本实例的大小来修改数据库集群。
question_zh_zh: 一个应用团队使用一个带有一个Aurora副本的Amazon Aurora MySQL数据库集群。当用户连接数超过200时，应用的读取性能会下降。用户连接数通常稳定在180左右，偶尔会突然增加超过200个连接。应用团队希望应用能够在用户需求增加或减少时自动扩展。哪种解决方案可以满足这些需求？

question: A company hosts a production database on an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) backed Amazon EC2 instance. As part of an annual disaster recovery exercise, the company needs to restore recent EBS snapshots to a new EC2 instance in a second Availability Zone.  After the snapshots are restored to EBS volumes, the resulting volumes must deliver all of their provisioned performance. The company must perform validation tests on the restored data as quickly as possible.  Which configuration will meet these requirements?
A: Enable EBS fast snapshot restore (FSR) on the snapshots for the second Availability Zone. Create new EBS volumes in the second Availability Zone from the snapshots. Attach the new EBS volumes to a new EC2 instance.
B: Enable EBS fast snapshot restore (FSR) on the snapshots for the current Availability Zone. Create new EBS volumes in the second Availability Zone from the snapshots, Attach the new EBS volumes to a new EC2 instance.
C: Specify Provisioned IOPS on the snapshots, Create new EBS volumes in the second Availability Zone from the snapshots. Attach the new EBS volumes to a new EC2 instance.
D: Specify Provisioned IOPS on the existing EBS volumes. Create the snapshots. After the snapshots are completed, create new EBS volumes in the second Availability Zone from the snapshots. Attach the new EBS volumes to a new EC2 instance.
question_zh: 一家公司在由Amazon Elastic Block Store（Amazon EBS）支持的Amazon EC2实例上托管生产数据库。作为年度灾难恢复演练的一部分，该公司需要将最近的EBS快照还原到第二个可用区中的新EC2实例。在快照还原到EBS卷后，生成的卷必须提供所有预配的性能。公司必须尽快对还原的数据进行验证测试。哪种配置能满足这些要求？
A_zh: 在第二个可用区的快照上启用EBS快速快照还原（FSR）。从快照中在第二个可用区创建新的EBS卷。将新的EBS卷附加到一个新的EC2实例。
B_zh: 在当前可用区的快照上启用EBS快速快照还原（FSR）。在第二个可用区使用快照创建新的EBS卷，将新的EBS卷附加到一个新的EC2实例上。
C_zh: 在快照上指定预配置的 IOPS，从快照在第二个可用区创建新的 EBS 卷。将新的 EBS 卷附加到一个新的 EC2 实例。
D_zh: 在现有的EBS卷上指定预配置的IOPS。创建快照。快照完成后，从快照在第二个可用区创建新的EBS卷。将新的EBS卷附加到一个新的EC2实例上。
question_zh_zh: 一家公司在由Amazon Elastic Block Store（Amazon EBS）支持的Amazon EC2实例上托管生产数据库。作为年度灾难恢复演练的一部分，该公司需要将最近的EBS快照还原到第二个可用区中的新EC2实例。在快照还原到EBS卷后，生成的卷必须提供所有预配的性能。公司必须尽快对还原的数据进行验证测试。哪种配置能满足这些要求？

question: A SysOps administrator is responsible for a legacy, CPU-heavy application. The application can only be scaled vertically. Currently, the application is deployed on a single t3.large Amazon EC2 instance. The system is showing 90% CPU usage and significant performance latency after a few minutes.  What change should be made to alleviate the performance problem?
A: Change the Amazon EBS volume to Provisioned IOPs.
B: Upgrade to a compute-optimized instance.
C: Add additional t2.large instances to the application.
D: Purchase Reserved Instances.
question_zh: SysOps 管理员负责一个遗留的、CPU密集型的应用程序。该应用程序只能进行垂直扩展。目前，应用程序部署在一个 t3.large 的 Amazon EC2 实例上。系统显示 CPU 使用率达到90%，并在几分钟后出现显著的性能延迟。应采取什么措施来缓解性能问题？
A_zh: 将 Amazon EBS 卷更改为预配置 IOPS。
B_zh: 升级到计算优化型实例。
C_zh: 向应用程序添加额外的 t2.large 实例。
D_zh: 购买预留实例。
question_zh_zh: SysOps 管理员负责一个遗留的、CPU密集型的应用程序。该应用程序只能进行垂直扩展。目前，应用程序部署在一个 t3.large 的 Amazon EC2 实例上。系统显示 CPU 使用率达到90%，并在几分钟后出现显著的性能延迟。应采取什么措施来缓解性能问题？

question: A user is connected to an Amazon EC2 instance in a private subnet. The user is unable to access the internet from the instance by using the following curl command: curl http:/www.example.com.  A SysOps administrator reviews the VPC configuration and learns the following information:  ? The private subnet has a route to a NAT gateway for CIDR 0.0.0.0/0 ? The outbound security group for the EC2 instance contains one rule: outbound for port 443 to CIDR 0.0.0.0/0 ? The inbound security group for the EC2 instance allows ports 22 and 443 from the user's IP address. ? The inbound network ACL for the subnet allows port 22 and port range 1024-65535 from CIDR 0.0.0.0/0  Which action will allow the user to complete the curl request successfully?
A: Add an additional inbound network ACL rule for port 80 to CIDR 0.0.0.0/0.
B: Add an additional inbound security group rule for port 80 to CIDR 0.0.0.0/0.
C: Add an additional outbound security group rule for port 80 to CIDR 0.0.0.0/0.
D: Add an additional outbound security group rule for port 80 to the user's IP address.
question_zh: 哪个操作将允许用户成功完成 curl 请求？
A_zh: 为端口80添加一条针对CIDR 0.0.0.0/0的入站网络ACL规则。
B_zh: 为端口80添加一条入站安全组规则，允许来自CIDR 0.0.0.0/0的访问。
C_zh: 为端口80添加一条针对CIDR 0.0.0.0/0的出站安全组规则。
D_zh: 为用户的IP地址添加一条端口80的出站安全组规则。
question_zh_zh: 哪个操作将允许用户成功完成 curl 请求？

question: A company��s financial department needs to view the cost details of each project in an AWS account. A SysOps administrator must perform the initial configuration that is required to view cost for each project in Cost Explorer.  Which solution will meet this requirement?
A: Activate cost allocation tags. Add a project tag to the appropriate resources.
B: Configure consolidated billing. Create AWS Cost and Usage Reports.
C: Use AWS Budgets. Create AWS Budgets reports.
D: Use cost categories to define custom groups that are based on AWS cost and usage dimensions.
question_zh: 一个公司的财务部门需要在AWS账户中查看每个项目的成本详情。一名SysOps管理员必须进行初始配置，以便在成本浏览器中查看每个项目的成本。哪种解决方案可以满足此需求？
A_zh: 激活成本分配标签。为相关资源添加项目标签。
B_zh: 配置合并账单。创建AWS成本与使用报告。
C_zh: 使用 AWS 预算。创建 AWS 预算报告。
D_zh: 使用成本类别定义基于AWS成本和使用维度的自定义组。
question_zh_zh: 使用AWS成本分配标签（Cost Allocation Tags）对每个项目进行标记，并在成本浏览器中启用这些标签，以便查看每个项目的成本详情。

question: A SysOps administrator is managing a web application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The instances run in an EC2 Auto Scaling group. The administrator wants to set an alarm for when all target instances associated with the ALB are unhealthy.  Which condition should be used with the alarm?
A: AWS/ApplicationELB HealthyHostCount <= 0
B: AWS/ApplicationELB UnhealthyHostCount >= 1
C: AWS/EC2 StatusCheckFailed <= 0
D: AWS/EC2 StatusCheckFailed >= 1
question_zh: 应使用“所有与ALB关联的目标实例都不健康”作为条件来设置警报。
A_zh: AWS/ApplicationELB 健康主机数 <= 0
B_zh: AWS/ApplicationELB 不健康主机数 >= 1
C_zh: AWS/EC2 状态检查失败次数 <= 0
D_zh: AWS/EC2 状态检查失败次数大于或等于1
question_zh_zh: 应使用“所有与ALB关联的目标实例都不健康”作为条件来设置警报。

question: A company uses AWS Organizations to manage its multi-account environment. The organization contains a dedicated account for security and a dedicated account for logging. A SysOps administrator needs to implement a centralized solution that provides alerts when a resource metric in any account crosses a standard defined threshold.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Deploy an AWS CloudFormation stack set to the accounts in the organization. Use a template that creates the required Amazon CloudWatch alarms and references an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic in the logging account with publish permissions for all the accounts.
B: Deploy an AWS CloudFormation stack in each account. Use the stack to deploy the required Amazon CloudWalch alarms and the required Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.
C: Deploy an AWS Lambda function on a cron job in each account. Configure the Lambda function to read resources that are in the account and to invoke an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic if any metrics cross the defined threshold.
D: Deploy an AWS CloudFormation change set to the organization. Use a template to create the required Amazon CloudWatch alarms and to send alerts to a verified Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) identity.
question_zh: 一家公司使用AWS Organizations来管理其多账户环境。该组织包含一个用于安全的专用账户和一个用于日志记录的专用账户。SysOps管理员需要实施一个集中式解决方案，在任何账户中的资源指标超过预定义阈值时提供警报。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？
A_zh: 在组织中的账户部署一个AWS CloudFormation堆栈集。使用一个创建所需Amazon CloudWatch警报的模板，并在日志账户中引用具有所有账户发布权限的Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）主题。
B_zh: 在每个账户中部署一个AWS CloudFormation堆栈。使用该堆栈部署所需的Amazon CloudWatch警报和所需的Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）主题。
C_zh: 在每个账户上部署一个AWS Lambda函数作为定时任务。配置该Lambda函数以读取账户中的资源，并在任何指标超过定义的阈值时调用Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）主题。
D_zh: 将AWS CloudFormation变更集部署到组织中。使用模板创建所需的Amazon CloudWatch警报，并将警报发送到已验证的Amazon Simple Email Service（Amazon SES）身份。
question_zh_zh: 一家公司使用AWS Organizations来管理其多账户环境。该组织包含一个用于安全的专用账户和一个用于日志记录的专用账户。SysOps管理员需要实施一个集中式解决方案，在任何账户中的资源指标超过预定义阈值时提供警报。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

question: A company has an application that uses a scheduled AWS Lambda function to retrieve datasets from external sources over the internet. The function is not associated with a VPC. The company is modifying the application to store the information that the Lambda function retrieves on an Amazon RDS DB instance in a private subnet. The VPC has two public subnets and two private subnets.  A SysOps administrator must deploy a solution that allows the Lambda function to access the new database and continue to access the internet.  Which solution meets these requirements?
A: Create a new Lambda function with VPC access and an Elastic IP address. Attach the function to public subnets in two Availability Zones. Associate a security group with the Elastic IP address. Configure the security group outbound rules to allow Lambda to access the required resources.
B: Create a new Lambda function with VPC access and two public IP addresses. Attach the function to public subnets in the same Availability Zones that the database uses. Associate a security group with the function. Configure the security group inbound rules to allow Lambda to access the required resources.
C: Reconfigure the Lambda function for VPC access. Add NAT gateways to the public subnets in the VPAdd route table entries in the private subnets to route through the NAT gateways to the internet. Attach the function to the private subnets that support the database. Associate a security group with the function. Configure the security group outbound rules to allow Lambda to access the internet.
D: Reconfigure the Lambda function for VPC access. Attach the function to the private subnets. Add route table entries in the private subnets to route through the internet gateway to the internet. Associate a security group with the subnets. Configure the security group inbound rules to allow Lambda to access the required resources through the internet gateway.
question_zh: 一家公司有一个应用程序，使用定时触发的AWS Lambda函数从互联网的外部来源检索数据集。该函数未与VPC关联。公司正在修改应用程序，将Lambda函数检索到的信息存储在私有子网中的Amazon RDS数据库实例上。该VPC有两个公共子网和两个私有子网。一名SysOps管理员必须部署一个解决方案，允许Lambda函数访问新的数据库并继续访问互联网。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？
A_zh: 创建一个具有VPC访问权限和弹性IP地址的新Lambda函数。将该函数关联到两个可用区的公共子网。将安全组与弹性IP地址关联。配置安全组的出站规则，允许Lambda访问所需的资源。
B_zh: 创建一个具有VPC访问权限和两个公共IP地址的新Lambda函数。将该函数关联到与数据库所在的可用区相同的公共子网中。为该函数关联一个安全组。配置安全组的入站规则，允许Lambda访问所需的资源。
C_zh: 重新配置 Lambda 函数以实现 VPC 访问。在公共子网中添加 NAT 网关，并在私有子网的路由表条目中通过 NAT 网关将流量路由到互联网。将该函数关联到支持数据库的私有子网。为该函数绑定安全组。配置安全组的出站规则，允许 Lambda 访问互联网。
D_zh: 重新配置Lambda函数以实现VPC访问。将该函数附加到私有子网。在私有子网中添加路由表条目，通过互联网网关路由到互联网。将安全组与子网关联。配置安全组的入站规则，允许Lambda通过互联网网关访问所需的资源。
question_zh_zh: 一家公司有一个应用程序，使用定时触发的AWS Lambda函数从互联网的外部来源检索数据集。该函数未与VPC关联。公司正在修改应用程序，将Lambda函数检索到的信息存储在私有子网中的Amazon RDS数据库实例上。该VPC有两个公共子网和两个私有子网。一名SysOps管理员必须部署一个解决方案，允许Lambda函数访问新的数据库并继续访问互联网。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

question: A company is running production workloads that use a Multi-AZ deployment of an Amazon RDS for MySQL db.m6g.xlarge (general purpose) standard DB instance. Users report that they are frequently encountering a ��too many connections�� error. A SysOps administrator observes that the number of connections on the database is high.  The SysOps administrator needs to resolve this issue while keeping code changes to a minimum.  Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
A: Modify the RDS for MySQL DB instance to a larger instance size.
B: Modify the RDS for MySQL DB instance to Amazon DynamoDB.
C: Configure RDS Proxy. Modify the application configuration file to use the RDS Proxy endpoint.
D: Modify the RDS for MySQL DB instance to a memory optimized DB instance.
question_zh: 一家公司正在运行使用多可用区部署的 Amazon RDS for MySQL db.m6g.xlarge（通用型）标准数据库实例的生产工作负载。用户报告他们经常遇到“连接过多”的错误。SysOps 管理员观察到数据库的连接数很高。SysOps 管理员需要在尽量少修改代码的情况下解决此问题。哪种解决方案最具成本效益地满足这些要求？
A_zh: 将MySQL数据库实例的RDS修改为更大的实例规格。
B_zh: 将MySQL数据库实例的RDS修改为Amazon DynamoDB。
C_zh: 配置 RDS 代理。修改应用程序配置文件以使用 RDS 代理端点。
D_zh: 将MySQL数据库实例的RDS修改为内存优化型数据库实例。
question_zh_zh: 一家公司正在运行使用多可用区部署的 Amazon RDS for MySQL db.m6g.xlarge（通用型）标准数据库实例的生产工作负载。用户报告他们经常遇到“连接过多”的错误。SysOps 管理员观察到数据库的连接数很高。SysOps 管理员需要在尽量少修改代码的情况下解决此问题。哪种解决方案最具成本效益地满足这些要求？

question: A company has multiple Amazon EC2 instances that run a resource-intensive application in a development environment. A SysOps administrator is implementing a solution to stop these EC2 instances when they are not in use.  Which solution will meet this requirement?
A: Assess AWS CloudTrail logs to verify that there is no EC2 API activity. Invoke an AWS Lambda function to stop the EC2 instances.
B: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to stop the EC2 instances when the average CPU utilization is lower than 5% for a 30-minute period.
C: Create an Amazon CloudWatch metric to stop the EC2 instances when the VolumeReadBytes metric is lower than 500 for a 30-minute period.
D: Use AWS Config to invoke an AWS Lambda function to stop the EC2 instances based on resource configuration changes.
question_zh: 一家公司在开发环境中运行资源密集型应用程序的多个Amazon EC2实例。一名SysOps管理员正在实施一种解决方案，以在这些实例未使用时停止它们。哪种解决方案可以满足此需求？
A_zh: 评估AWS CloudTrail日志以确认没有EC2 API活动。调用AWS Lambda函数以停止EC2实例。
B_zh: 创建一个Amazon CloudWatch警报，当平均CPU利用率在30分钟内低于5%时停止EC2实例。
C_zh: 创建一个Amazon CloudWatch指标，当VolumeReadBytes指标在30分钟内低于500时，停止EC2实例。
D_zh: 使用 AWS Config 调用 AWS Lambda 函数，根据资源配置变更停止 EC2 实例。
question_zh_zh: 哪种解决方案可以在这些实例未使用时停止它们，以满足这一需求？

question: A company has a web application with a database tier that consists of an Amazon EC2 instance that runs MySQL. A SysOps administrator needs to minimize potential data loss and the time that is required to recover in the event of a database failure.  What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that meets these requirements?
A: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm for the StatusCheckFailed_System metric to invoke an AWS Lambda function that stops and starts the EC2 instance.
B: Create an Amazon RDS for MySQL Multi-AZ DB instance. Use a MySQL native backup that is stored in Amazon S3 to restore the data to the new database. Update the connection string in the web application.
C: Create an Amazon RDS for MySQL Single-AZ DB instance with a read replica. Use a MySQL native backup that is stored in Amazon S3 to restore the data to the new database. Update the connection string in the web application
D: Use Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (Amazon DLM) to take a snapshot of the Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume every hour. In the event of an EC2 instance failure, restore the EBS volume from a snapshot.
question_zh: 一家公司拥有一个包含数据库层的Web应用程序，该数据库层由一台运行MySQL的Amazon EC2实例组成。SysOps管理员需要最大程度地减少潜在的数据丢失以及在数据库故障时恢复所需的时间。满足这些要求的最具操作效率的解决方案是什么？
A_zh: 为 StatusCheckFailed_System 指标创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 警报，以调用 AWS Lambda 函数，停止并启动 EC2 实例。
B_zh: 创建一个Amazon RDS for MySQL多可用区数据库实例。使用存储在Amazon S3中的MySQL原生备份将数据还原到新数据库中。更新Web应用程序中的连接字符串。
C_zh: 创建一个带有只读副本的 Amazon RDS for MySQL 单可用区数据库实例。使用存储在 Amazon S3 中的 MySQL 原生备份将数据还原到新数据库中。更新网页应用程序中的连接字符串。
D_zh: 使用 Amazon 数据生命周期管理器（Amazon DLM）每小时对 Amazon 弹性块存储（Amazon EBS）卷进行快照。在 EC2 实例发生故障时，从快照中还原 EBS 卷。
question_zh_zh: 一家公司拥有一个包含数据库层的Web应用程序，该数据库层由一台运行MySQL的Amazon EC2实例组成。SysOps管理员需要最大程度地减少潜在的数据丢失以及在数据库故障时恢复所需的时间。满足这些要求的最具操作效率的解决方案是什么？

question: A company uses AWS CloudFormation to manage a stack of Amazon EC2 instances on AWS. A SysOps administrator needs to keep the instances and all of the instances�� data, even if someone deletes the stack.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Set the DeletionPolicy attribute to Snapshot for the EC2 instance resource in the CloudFormation template.
B: Automate backups by using Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (Amazon DLM).
C: Create a backup plan in AWS Backup.
D: Set the DeletionPolicy attribute to Retain for the EC2 instance resource in the CloudFormation template.
question_zh: 一家公司使用AWS CloudFormation来管理AWS上的一组Amazon EC2实例。一名SysOps管理员需要确保这些实例及其所有数据，即使有人删除了堆栈，也能得到保留。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？
A_zh: 在CloudFormation模板中，将EC2实例资源的DeletionPolicy属性设置为Snapshot。
B_zh: 使用Amazon数据生命周期管理器（Amazon DLM）自动备份。
C_zh: 在AWS Backup中创建备份计划。
D_zh: 在CloudFormation模板中，将EC2实例资源的DeletionPolicy属性设置为Retain。
question_zh_zh: 使用AWS CloudFormation的堆栈保护功能，启用堆栈保护以防止意外删除，同时为实例配置快照或备份策略，以确保数据的持久性和可恢复性。

question: Accompany wants to monitor the number of Amazon EC2 instances that it is running. The company also wants to automate a service quota increase when the number of instances reaches a specific threshold.  Which solution meets these requirements?
A: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to monitor Service Quotas. Configure the alarm to invoke an AWS Lambda function to request a quota increase when the alarm reaches the threshold.
B: Create an AWS Config rule to monitor Service Quotas. Call an AWS Lambda function to remediate the action and increase the quota.
C: Create an Amazon CloudWateh alarm to monitor the AWS Health Dashboard. Configure the alarm to invoke an AWS Lambda function to request a quota increase when the alarm reaches the threshold.
D: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to monitor AWS Trusted Advisor service quotas. Configure the alarm to publish a message to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to increase the quota.
question_zh: Accompany 想要监控其运行的 Amazon EC2 实例数量。当实例数量达到特定阈值时，公司还希望自动增加服务配额。哪种解决方案可以满足这些需求？
A_zh: 创建一个Amazon CloudWatch警报以监控服务配额。当警报达到阈值时，配置该警报调用AWS Lambda函数以请求配额增加。
B_zh: 创建一个AWS Config规则以监控服务配额。调用AWS Lambda函数进行补救操作并增加配额。
C_zh: 创建一个Amazon CloudWatch警报，用于监控AWS健康仪表板。当警报达到阈值时，配置该警报调用AWS Lambda函数以请求配额增加。
D_zh: 创建一个Amazon CloudWatch警报，用于监控AWS Trusted Advisor服务配额。将该警报配置为向Amazon Simple Notification Service（Amazon SNS）主题发布消息，以增加配额。
question_zh_zh: Accompany 想要监控其运行的 Amazon EC2 实例数量。当实例数量达到特定阈值时，公司还希望自动增加服务配额。哪种解决方案可以满足这些需求？

question: A SysOps administrator is responsible for more than 50 Amazon EC2 instances that are deployed in a single production AWS account. The EC2 instances are running several different operating systems. The company's standards require patching to be completed at least once a month.  The SysOps administrator wants to use AWS Systems Manager to reduce the number of hours the company spends on operating system patching each month.  Which combination of steps should the SysOps administrator take to meet these requirements? (Choose three.)
A: Group similar EC2 instances together into resource groups by using AWS Resource Groups.
B: Create a schedule in Systems Manager Patch Manager. Specify the appropriate resource group as the target.
C: Specify Systems Manager Automation runbooks to patch the operating systems. Register the runbooks as tasks in the maintenance window. Specify the appropriate resource group as the target.
D: Create a Systems Manager Automation runbook to monitor and control the state of the patches required. Apply the runbook to Systems Manager Patch Manager.
E: Create a single Systems Manager maintenance window for each resource group.
F: Configure Systems Manager Fleet Manager to apply a Systems Manager Automation runbook to the appropriate resource group.
question_zh: 一名SysOps管理员负责在单一生产AWS账户中部署的50多个Amazon EC2实例。这些EC2实例运行着多种不同的操作系统。公司的标准要求每月至少完成一次补丁更新。SysOps管理员希望使用AWS Systems Manager来减少公司每月在操作系统补丁上的工作时间。SysOps管理员应采取哪些步骤组合以满足这些要求？（选择三个）
A_zh: 使用 AWS 资源组将类似的 EC2 实例分组到资源组中。
B_zh: 在系统管理器补丁管理器中创建一个计划。将适当的资源组指定为目标。
C_zh: 指定系统管理器自动化运行手册以修补操作系统。将运行手册注册为维护窗口中的任务。将适当的资源组指定为目标。
D_zh: 创建一个系统管理器自动化运行手册，用于监控和控制所需补丁的状态。将该运行手册应用于系统管理器补丁管理器。
E_zh: 为每个资源组创建一个单一的系统管理器维护窗口。
F_zh: 配置系统管理器舰队管理器，以将系统管理器自动化运行手册应用于相应的资源组。
question_zh_zh: 一名SysOps管理员负责在单一生产AWS账户中部署的50多个Amazon EC2实例。这些EC2实例运行着多种不同的操作系统。公司的标准要求每月至少完成一次补丁更新。SysOps管理员希望使用AWS Systems Manager来减少公司每月在操作系统补丁上的工作时间。SysOps管理员应采取哪些步骤组合以满足这些要求？（选择三个）

question: A company has multiple AWS accounts. The company uses AWS Organizations with an organizational unit (OU) for the production account and another OU for the development account. Corporate policies state that developers may use only approved AWS services in the production account.  What is the MOST operationally efficient solution to control the production account?
A: Create a customer managed policy in AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM). Apply the policy to all users within the production account.
B: Create a job function policy in AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM). Apply the policy to all users within the production OU.
C: Create a service control policy (SCP). Apply the SCP to the production OU.
D: Create an IAM policy. Apply the policy in Amazon API Gateway to restrict the production account.
question_zh: 公司拥有多个AWS账户。公司使用AWS组织，并为生产账户和开发账户分别设置了一个组织单元（OU）。公司政策规定，开发人员只能在生产账户中使用已批准的AWS服务。控制生产账户的最具操作效率的解决方案是什么？
A_zh: 在AWS身份与访问管理（IAM）中创建一个客户管理策略。将该策略应用于生产账户中的所有用户。
B_zh: 在AWS身份与访问管理（IAM）中创建一个岗位职能策略。将该策略应用于生产组织单位（OU）内的所有用户。
C_zh: 创建一项服务控制策略（SCP）。将该SCP应用于生产组织单位（OU）。
D_zh: 创建一个IAM策略。在Amazon API Gateway中应用该策略，以限制生产账户。
question_zh_zh: 控制生产账户的最具操作效率的解决方案是什么？

question: A company has applications that process transaction requests multiple times each minute. The applications write transaction data to a single Amazon RDS DB instance. As the company begins to process more transactions, the company becomes concerned that it has no failover solution in place for disaster recovery (DR). The company needs the DB instance to fail over automatically without losing any committed transactions.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Create an RDS read replica in the same AWS Region. Configure an AWS Lambda function to promote the replica as the primary DB instance during a DR scenario.
B: Create an RDS read replica in a different AWS Region. Configure an AWS Lambda function to promote the replica as the primary DB instance during a DR scenario.
C: Modify the DB instance to be a Multi-AZ deployment.
D: Setup an Amazon CloudWatch alarm that monitors the DB instance memory utilization with a threshold greater than 90%. Invoke an AWS Lambda function to restart the DB instance.
question_zh: 一家公司有应用程序每分钟多次处理交易请求。这些应用程序将交易数据写入一个Amazon RDS数据库实例。随着公司开始处理更多的交易，公司担心没有灾难恢复（DR）的故障转移解决方案。公司需要数据库实例能够自动故障转移且不丢失任何已提交的交易。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？
A_zh: 在同一AWS区域创建一个RDS只读副本。在灾难恢复场景中，配置一个AWS Lambda函数将副本提升为主数据库实例。
B_zh: 在不同的AWS区域创建一个RDS只读副本。在灾难恢复场景中，配置一个AWS Lambda函数将副本提升为主数据库实例。
C_zh: 将数据库实例修改为多可用区部署。
D_zh: 设置一个监控数据库实例内存利用率的Amazon CloudWatch警报，阈值设定为超过90%。调用AWS Lambda函数以重启数据库实例。
question_zh_zh: 一家公司有应用程序每分钟多次处理交易请求。这些应用程序将交易数据写入一个Amazon RDS数据库实例。随着公司开始处理更多的交易，公司担心没有灾难恢复（DR）的故障转移解决方案。公司需要数据库实例能够自动故障转移且不丢失任何已提交的交易。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

question: ASysOps administrator configures an application to run on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in a simple scaling Auto Scaling group with the default settings. The Auto Scaling group is configured to use the RequestCountPerTarget metric for scaling. The SysOps administrator notices that the RequestCountPerTarget metric exceeded the specified limit twice in 180 seconds.  How will the number of EC2 instances in this Auto Scaling group be affected in this scenario?
A: The Auto Scaling group will launch an additional EC2 instance every time the RequestCountPerTarget metric exceeds the predefined limit.
B: The Auto Scaling group will launch one EC2 instance and will wait for the default cooldown period before launching another instance.
C: The Auto Scaling group will send an alert to the ALB to rebalance the traffic and not add new EC2 instances until the load is normalized.
D: The Auto Scaling group will try to distribute the traffic among all EC2 instances before launching another instance.
question_zh: 在这种情况下，Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 实例数量将会增加。
A_zh: 当 RequestCountPerTarget 指标超过预设限制时，自动扩展组将启动一个额外的 EC2 实例。
B_zh: 自动扩展组将启动一个EC2实例，并在启动另一个实例之前等待默认的冷却时间。
C_zh: 自动扩展组将向应用负载均衡器（ALB）发送警报，以重新平衡流量，并在负载恢复正常之前不添加新的EC2实例。
D_zh: 自动扩展组将在启动新实例之前，尝试在所有EC2实例之间分配流量。
question_zh_zh: In this case, the number of EC2 instances in the Auto Scaling group will increase.

question: A company has a secure website running on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). An SSL certificate from AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) is used on the ALB. Users with legacy web browsers are experiencing issues with the website.  How should the SysOps administrator resolve these issues in the MOST operationally efficient manner?
A: Create a new SSL certificate in ACM and install the new certificate on the ALB to support legacy web browsers.
B: Create a second ALB and install a custom SSL certificate with a different domain name on the second ALB to support legacy web browsers.
C: Remove the ALB from the configuration and install a custom SSL certificate on each web server.
D: Update the SSL negotiation configuration of the ALB with a security policy that contains ciphers for legacy web browsers.
question_zh: 一家公司在应用程序负载均衡器（ALB）后面运行着一个安全网站，使用来自AWS证书管理器（ACM）的SSL证书。使用旧版网页浏览器的用户在访问该网站时遇到问题。系统运维管理员应以最高的运营效率解决这些问题，应该怎么做？
A_zh: 在ACM中创建一个新的SSL证书，并将新证书安装到ALB上，以支持旧版网页浏览器。
B_zh: 创建第二个应用负载均衡器（ALB），并在第二个ALB上安装带有不同域名的自定义SSL证书，以支持旧版网页浏览器。
C_zh: 从配置中移除ALB，并在每台Web服务器上安装自定义SSL证书。
D_zh: 使用包含旧版网页浏览器支持密码套件的安全策略，更新ALB的SSL协商配置。
question_zh_zh:
为了以最高的运营效率解决使用旧版网页浏览器的用户在访问安全网站时遇到的问题，系统运维管理员应采取以下措施：

1. 检查ALB的SSL策略：确保ALB配置使用支持旧版浏览器的SSL/TLS协议版本（如TLS 1.0或TLS 1.1），以兼容较旧的浏览器。
2. 更新ACM证书配置：确认证书配置正确，并确保ALB绑定的SSL证书有效且支持所需的协议版本。
3. 兼容性测试：使用不同版本的旧浏览器进行测试，确认问题是否已解决。
4. 提供通知和建议：通知用户升级浏览器以获得更好的安全性和兼容性，减少对旧版浏览器的依赖。
5. 考虑逐步淘汰旧浏览器：制定策略逐步淘汰对不安全协议的支持，鼓励用户使用现代浏览器。

通过调整ALB的SSL策略和配置，确保兼容旧浏览器的同时，也保障网站的安全性。

question: A company hosts an internet web application on Amazon EC2 instances. The company is replacing the application with a new AWS Lambda function. During a transition period, the company must route some traffic to the legacy application and some traffic to the new Lambda function. The company needs to use the URL path of request to determine the routing.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Configure a Gateway Load Balancer to use the URL path to direct traffic to the legacy application and the new Lambda function.
B: Configure a Network Load Balancer to use the URL path to direct traffic to the legacy application and the new Lambda function.
C: Configure a Network Load Balancer to use a regular expression to match the URL path to direct traffic to the new Lambda function.
D: Configure an Application Load Balancer to use the URL path to direct traffic to the legacy application and the new Lambda function.
question_zh: 公司在 Amazon EC2 实例上托管一个互联网网页应用程序。公司正在用一个新的 AWS Lambda 函数替换该应用程序。在过渡期间，公司必须将部分流量路由到遗留应用程序，部分流量路由到新的 Lambda 函数。公司需要根据请求的 URL 路径来确定路由。哪种解决方案可以满足这些需求？
A_zh: 配置网关负载均衡器，使用URL路径将流量引导到遗留应用程序和新的Lambda函数。
B_zh: 配置网络负载均衡器，使用URL路径将流量引导到遗留应用程序和新的Lambda函数。
C_zh: 配置网络负载均衡器，使用正则表达式匹配URL路径，将流量引导到新的Lambda函数。
D_zh: 配置应用程序负载均衡器，使用URL路径将流量引导到遗留应用程序和新的Lambda函数。
question_zh_zh: 使用 Amazon API Gateway 配合 Lambda 和现有的 EC2 实例，通过基于请求 URL 路径的路由规则，将部分流量导向遗留应用程序，部分流量导向新的 Lambda 函数。

question: A SysOps administrator launches an Amazon EC2 Linux instance in a public subnet. When the instance is running, the SysOps administrator obtains the public IP address and attempts to remotely connect to the Instance multiple times. However, the SysOps administrator always receives a timeout error.  Which action will allow the SysOps administrator to remotely connect to the instance?
A: Add a route table entry in the public subnet for the SysOps administrator's IP address.
B: Add an outbound network ACL rule to allow TCP port 22 for the SysOps administrator's IP address.
C: Modify the instance security group to allow inbound SSH traffic from the SysOps administrator's IP address.
D: Modify the instance security group to allow outbound SSH traffic to the SysOps administrator's IP address.
question_zh: SysOps 管理员在公共子网中启动了一个 Amazon EC2 Linux 实例。当实例运行时，SysOps 管理员获取了公共 IP 地址并多次尝试远程连接到实例。然而，SysOps 管理员总是收到超时错误。哪项操作可以让 SysOps 管理员远程连接到该实例？
A_zh: 在公共子网中为SysOps管理员的IP地址添加一条路由表条目。
B_zh: 添加一条出站网络ACL规则，允许SysOps管理员的IP地址通过TCP端口22。
C_zh: 修改实例的安全组，允许来自SysOps管理员IP地址的入站SSH流量。
D_zh: 修改实例的安全组，允许出站SSH流量到SysOps管理员的IP地址。
question_zh_zh: 在安全组中添加允许入站 SSH（端口22）流量的规则。

question: A company needs to deploy a new workload on AWS. The company must encrypt all data at rest and must rotate the encryption keys once each year. The workload uses an Amazon RDS for MySQL Multi-AZ database for data storage.  Which configuration approach will meet these requirements?
A: Enable Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) in the MySQL configuration file. Manually rotate the key every 12 months.
B: Enable RDS encryption on the database at creation time by using the AWS managed key for Amazon RDS.
C: Create a new AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Enable automatic key rotation. Enable RDS encryption on the database at creation time by using the KMS key.
D: Create a new AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Enable automatic key rotation. Enable encryption on the Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes that are attached to the RDS DB instance.
question_zh: 公司需要在AWS上部署新的工作负载。公司必须对所有静态数据进行加密，并且每年轮换一次加密密钥。该工作负载使用Amazon RDS for MySQL多可用区数据库进行数据存储。哪种配置方案能够满足这些要求？
A_zh: 在MySQL配置文件中启用透明数据加密（TDE）。每12个月手动轮换一次密钥。
B_zh: 在创建数据库时，使用AWS托管密钥为Amazon RDS启用加密。
C_zh: 创建一个新的AWS密钥管理服务（AWS KMS）客户管理密钥。启用自动密钥轮换。在创建数据库时，使用该KMS密钥启用RDS加密。
D_zh: 创建一个新的AWS密钥管理服务（AWS KMS）客户管理密钥。启用自动密钥轮换。在连接到RDS数据库实例的Amazon弹性块存储（Amazon EBS）卷上启用加密。
question_zh_zh: 公司需要在AWS上部署新的工作负载。公司必须对所有静态数据进行加密，并且每年轮换一次加密密钥。该工作负载使用Amazon RDS for MySQL多可用区数据库进行数据存储。哪种配置方案能够满足这些要求？

question: A company runs a high performance computing (HPC) application on an Amazon EC2 instance. The company needs to scale this architecture to two or more EC2 instances. The EC2 instances will need to communicate with each other at high speeds with low latency to support the application.  The company wants to ensure that the network performance can support the required communication between the EC2 instances  What should a SysOps administrator do to meet these requirements?
A: Create a cluster placement group. Back up the existing EC2 instance to an Amazon Machine Image (AMI). Restore the EC2 instance from the AMI into the placement group. Launch the additional EC2 instances into the placement group.
B: Back up the existing EC2 instance to an Amazon Machine Image (AMI). Create a launch template from the existing EC2 instance by specifying the AMI. Create an Auto Scaling group and configure the desired instance count.
C: Create a Network Load Balancer (NLB) and a target group. Launch the new EC2 instances and register them with the target group. Register the existing EC2 instance with the target group. Pass all application traffic through the NLB.
D: Back up the existing EC2 instance to an Amazon Machine Image (AMI). Create additional clones of the EC2 instance from the AMI in the same Availability Zone where the existing EC2 instance is located.
question_zh: 一家公司在Amazon EC2实例上运行高性能计算（HPC）应用程序。该公司需要将此架构扩展到两个或更多的EC2实例。这些EC2实例需要以高速、低延迟进行相互通信，以支持该应用程序。公司希望确保网络性能能够满足EC2实例之间所需的通信。SysOps管理员应采取哪些措施以满足这些要求？
A_zh: 创建一个集群放置组。将现有的EC2实例备份为Amazon机器映像（AMI）。将EC2实例从该AMI还原到放置组中。将额外的EC2实例启动到该放置组中。
B_zh: 将现有的EC2实例备份为Amazon机器映像（AMI）。通过指定AMI从现有的EC2实例创建一个启动模板。创建一个自动扩展组并配置所需的实例数量。
C_zh: 创建一个网络负载均衡器（NLB）和一个目标组。启动新的EC2实例并将它们注册到目标组中。将现有的EC2实例注册到目标组中。通过NLB传递所有应用程序流量。
D_zh: 将现有的EC2实例备份为Amazon机器映像（AMI）。在与现有EC2实例相同的可用区内，从该AMI创建额外的EC2实例克隆。
question_zh_zh: 公司应考虑使用弹性网络适配器（ENA）以实现高速低延迟的网络通信，确保EC2实例之间的网络性能。此外，可以启用增强型网络功能，使用Placement Groups（放置组）将实例放置在同一物理硬件上，以减少延迟和提高带宽。还应确保选择支持高性能网络的实例类型，并优化网络配置以满足应用程序的通信需求。

question: A developer creates an AWS Lambda function that runs when an object is put into an Amazon S3 bucket. The function reformats the object and places the object back into the S3 bucket. During testing, the developer notices a recursive invocation loop. The developer asks a SysOps administrator to immediately stop the recursive invocations.  What should the SysOps administrator do to stop the loop without errors?
A: Delete all the objects from the S3 bucket.
B: Set the function��s reserved concurrency to 0.
C: Update the S3 bucket policy to deny access for the function.
D: Publish a new version of the function.
question_zh: SysOps管理员应禁用触发该Lambda函数的S3事件通知，或者暂时删除相关的事件通知配置，以阻止递归调用循环，而不会引发错误。
A_zh: 删除S3存储桶中的所有对象。
B_zh: 将该函数的预留并发数设置为0。
C_zh: 更新S3存储桶策略，拒绝该函数的访问。
D_zh: 发布该函数的新版本。
question_zh_zh: SysOps管理员应禁用触发该Lambda函数的S3事件通知，或暂时删除相关的事件通知配置，以防止递归调用循环，而不会引发错误。

question: A company has an application that runs behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in the us-west-2 Region. An Amazon Route 53 record set contains an alias record for app.anycompany.com that references the ALB in us-west-2 and uses a simple routing policy. The application is experiencing an increase in users from other locations in the world. These users are experiencing high latency.  Most of the new users are close to the ap-southeast-2 Region. The company deploys a copy of the application to ap-southeast-2. A SysOps administrator must implement a solution that automatically routes requests to the lowest latency endpoint for users without changing the URL.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Add a new value to the existing alias record for app.anycompany.com with the DNS name of the new ALB in ap-southeast-2.
B: Change the existing alias record to use a geolocation routing policy. Create two geolocation records, one record that references each ALSelect the location that is closest to each Region.
C: Change the existing alias record to use a latency routing policy. Create two latency records, one record that references each ALB.
D: Change the existing alias record to use a multivalue routing policy Add the DNS name of each ALB to the record.
question_zh: 一家公司在 us-west-2 区域有一个应用程序，该应用程序在应用程序负载均衡器（ALB）后面运行。一个 Amazon Route 53 记录集包含一个别名记录，指向 us-west-2 区域的 ALB，并使用简单路由策略。该应用程序的用户数量在全球其他地区不断增加，用户体验到较高的延迟。大部分新用户靠近 ap-southeast-2 区域。公司在 ap-southeast-2 部署了应用程序的副本。SysOps 管理员必须实施一种解决方案，自动将请求路由到延迟最低的端点，以改善用户体验，而无需更改 URL。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？
A_zh: 在ap-southeast-2区域中，将新ALB的DNS名称添加为app.anycompany.com现有别名记录的新值。
B_zh: 将现有的别名记录更改为使用地理位置路由策略。创建两个地理位置记录，每个记录引用一个AL，选择最接近每个区域的位置。
C_zh: 将现有的别名记录更改为使用延迟路由策略。创建两个延迟记录，每个记录引用一个应用负载均衡器（ALB）。
D_zh: 将现有的别名记录更改为使用多值路由策略，添加每个ALB的DNS名称到该记录中。
question_zh_zh: 一种解决方案是使用 Amazon Route 53 的延迟路由策略。通过将现有的别名记录转换为延迟路由策略，Route 53 会根据用户的地理位置自动将请求路由到延迟最低的端点，从而改善用户体验，无需更改 URL。

question: A company stores files on 50 Amazon S3 buckets in the same AWS Region. The company wants to connect to the S3 buckets securely over a private connection from its Amazon EC2 instances. The company needs a solution that produces no additional cost.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Create a gateway VPC endpoint for each S3 bucket. Attach the gateway VPC endpoints to each subnet inside the VPC.
B: Create an interface VPC endpoint for each S3 bucket. Attach the interface VPC endpoints to each subnet inside the VPC.
C: Create one gateway VPC endpoint for all the S3 buckets. Add the gateway VPC endpoint to the VPC route table.
D: Create one interface VPC endpoint for all the S3 buckets. Add the interface VPC endpoint to the VPC route table.
question_zh: 公司在同一AWS区域的50个Amazon S3存储桶中存储文件。公司希望通过私有连接从其Amazon EC2实例安全地连接到这些S3存储桶。公司需要一种不产生额外成本的解决方案。哪种方案可以满足这些要求？
A_zh: 为每个S3存储桶创建一个网关VPC端点。将网关VPC端点附加到VPC内的每个子网。
B_zh: 为每个S3存储桶创建一个接口VPC端点。将接口VPC端点附加到VPC内的每个子网。
C_zh: 为所有的S3存储桶创建一个网关VPC端点。将该网关VPC端点添加到VPC路由表中。
D_zh: 为所有的S3桶创建一个接口VPC端点。将接口VPC端点添加到VPC路由表中。
question_zh_zh: 使用VPC终端节点（VPC Endpoint）连接S3存储桶。

question: A company's security policy states that connecting to Amazon EC2 instances is not permitted through SSH and ROP. If access is required, authorized staff can connect to instances by using AWS Systems Manager Session Manager.  Users report that they are unable to connect to one specific Amazon EC2 instance that is running Ubuntu and has AWS Systems Manager Agent (SSM Agent) pre-installed. These users are able to use Session Manager to connect to other instances in the same subnet, and they are in an IAM group that has Session Manager permission for all instances.  What should a SysOps administrator do to resolve this issue?
A: Add an inbound rule for port 22 in the security group associated with the Ubuntu instance.
B: Assign the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore managed policy to the EC2 instance profile for the Ubuntu instance.
C: Configure the SSM Agent to log in with a user name of ��ubuntu��.
D: Generate a new key pair, configure Session Manager to use this new key pair, and provide the private key to the users.
question_zh: 一家公司安全政策规定不允许通过SSH和ROP连接到Amazon EC2实例。如果需要访问，授权员工可以使用AWS Systems Manager Session Manager连接实例。用户报告无法连接到一台运行Ubuntu且预装AWS Systems Manager Agent（SSM Agent）的特定Amazon EC2实例。这些用户能够使用Session Manager连接到同一子网中的其他实例，并且他们属于具有所有实例Session Manager权限的IAM组。SysOps管理员应采取什么措施来解决此问题？
A_zh: 在与Ubuntu实例关联的安全组中，为端口22添加入站规则。
B_zh: 将 AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore 管理策略分配给 Ubuntu 实例的 EC2 实例配置文件。
C_zh: 将SSM代理配置为使用用户名“ubuntu”登录。
D_zh: 生成一对新密钥，配置会话管理器使用这对新密钥，并将私钥提供给用户。
question_zh_zh: SysOps管理员应检查该特定实例的SSM Agent是否已正确安装、配置并运行，确保该实例已正确加入到AWS Systems Manager的管理范围内。此外，还应验证该实例的IAM角色是否具有必要的权限，以及网络配置（如安全组和网络ACL）是否允许通信。必要时，可以重新安装或更新SSM Agent，并确认实例已正确注册到Systems Manager。

question: A SysOps administrator is configuring Amazon CloudWatch alarms. A particular is constantly in the ALARM state.  What could be the reason for this issue?
A: Alarms continue to evaluate metrics against configured thresholds, even after they are triggered.
B: After alarms are triggered, they remain in the ALARM state until they are manually disabled.
C: After an alarm is triggered and an action is performed, the application logic must reset the alarm to its normal state.
D: The alarm is not receiving appropriate metrics.
question_zh: SysOps 管理员正在配置 Amazon CloudWatch 警报。某个警报一直处于“警报”状态。造成这个问题的原因可能是什么？
A_zh: 警报在被触发后，仍会持续评估指标是否达到预设阈值。
B_zh: 报警被触发后，它们会一直处于报警状态，直到手动将其禁用。
C_zh: 在触发警报并执行操作后，应用程序逻辑必须将警报重置为正常状态。
D_zh: 警报未收到适当的指标。
question_zh_zh: SysOps 管理员正在配置 Amazon CloudWatch 警报。某个警报一直处于“警报”状态。造成这个问题的原因可能是什么？

question: A company has set up an IPsec tunnel between its AWS environment and its on-premises data center. The tunnel is reporting as UP, but the Amazon EC2 instances are not able to ping any on-premises resources.  What should a SysOps administrator do to resolve this issue?
A: Create a new inbound rule on the EC2 instances�� security groups to allow ICMP traffic from the on-premises CIDR.
B: Create a peering connection between the IPsec tunnel and the subnet of the EC2 instances.
C: Enable route propagation for the virtual private gateway in the route table that is assigned to the subnet of the EC2 instances.
D: Modify the VPC��s DHCP options set. Add the IPsec tunnel to the VPN section.
question_zh: 一家公司在其AWS环境与本地数据中心之间建立了IPsec隧道。该隧道显示为正常连接，但Amazon EC2实例无法ping通任何本地资源。SysOps管理员应采取什么措施来解决此问题？
A_zh: 在EC2实例的安全组上创建一条新的入站规则，允许来自本地CIDR的ICMP流量。
B_zh: 在IPsec隧道和EC2实例的子网之间创建对等连接。
C_zh: 在分配给EC2实例子网的路由表中启用虚拟私有网关的路由传播。
D_zh: 修改VPC的DHCP选项集。将IPsec隧道添加到VPN部分。
question_zh_zh: SysOps管理员应检查IPsec隧道的配置，包括本地和云端的安全组、网络ACL以及路由设置，确保允许ICMP流量通过。同时，验证本地网络设备的配置，确保没有阻止来自AWS的ping请求。

question: A company hosts a production MySQL database on an Amazon Aurora single-node DB cluster. The database is queried heavily for reporting purposes. The DB cluster is experiencing periods of performance degradation because of high CPU utilization and maximum connections errors. A SysOps administrator needs to improve the stability of the database.  Which solution will meet these requirements?
A: Create an Aurora Replica node. Create an Auto Scaling policy to scale replicas based on CPU utilization. Ensure that all reporting requests use the read-only connection string
B: Create a second Aurora MySQL single-node DB cluster in a second Availability Zone. Ensure that all reporting requests use the connection string for this additional node
C: Create an AWS Lambda function that caches reporting requests. Ensure that all reporting requests call the Lambda function
D: Create a multi-node Amazon ElastiCache cluster. Ensure that all reporting requests use the ElastiCache cluster. Use the database if the data is not in the cache.
question_zh: 一家公司在亚马逊Aurora单节点数据库集群上托管一个生产MySQL数据库。该数据库用于大量查询报告。由于CPU利用率过高和连接数达到最大限制，数据库集群出现性能下降的情况。一名SysOps管理员需要提高数据库的稳定性。哪种解决方案能满足这些需求？
A_zh: 创建一个Aurora副本节点。创建一个自动缩放策略，根据CPU利用率进行副本的扩缩。确保所有报告请求都使用只读连接字符串。
B_zh: 在第二个可用区创建一个第二个 Aurora MySQL 单节点数据库集群。确保所有报告请求都使用该额外节点的连接字符串。
C_zh: 创建一个AWS Lambda函数，用于缓存报告请求。确保所有报告请求都调用该Lambda函数。
D_zh: 创建一个多节点的Amazon ElastiCache集群。确保所有的报告请求都使用ElastiCache集群。如果缓存中没有数据，则使用数据库。
question_zh_zh: 一家公司在亚马逊Aurora单节点数据库集群上托管一个生产MySQL数据库。该数据库用于大量查询报告。由于CPU利用率过高和连接数达到最大限制，数据库集群出现性能下降的情况。一名SysOps管理员需要提高数据库的稳定性。哪种解决方案能满足这些需求？

question: A company runs a web application that users access using the name www example com. The company manages the domain name example.com using Amazon Route 53. The company created an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the application and would like www.example.com to access the application through CloudFront.  What is the MOST cost-effective way to achieve this?
A: Create a CNAME record in Amazon Route 53 that points to the CloudFront distribution URL.
B: Create an ALIAS record in Amazon Route 53 that points to the CioudFront distribution URL.
C: Create an A record in Amazon Route 53 that points to the public IP address of the web application,
D: Create a PTR record in Amazon Route 53 that points to the public IP address of the web application.
question_zh: 公司运行一个网络应用，用户通过 www.example.com 访问。公司使用 Amazon Route 53 管理域名 example.com。公司在应用前面创建了一个 Amazon CloudFront 分发，并希望通过 CloudFront 让 www.example.com 访问该应用。实现这一目标的最经济有效的方法是什么？
